notes.title: 🏰 New Guardian Armor, Bandanas, and Blades this week!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/78b504fdea3d25cb0c05de457ad357f6c434e27e.png"]Battleon Guardians, Bandanas, Statues, Sovereign Blades, & Boss + Gold Updates[p align="-webkit-left"]Guardians can now claim the brand-new Battleon Guardian Armor, a modern take on the iconic gear from the original AdventureQuest. While the Guardian Tower is still being built, Solestia is handing out this legendary look in both versions of Battleon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb2efab376b1c5f2ccb76f1d9ce9c5792293b9bd.png"]
Bandanas Ahoy![p align="-webkit-left"]Get ready for Talk Like a Pirate Day with a bandana that fits your swashbuckling style. Start your quest at the Quest Board in Battleon, which will lead you to Marina Gomes in Lolosia to choose your perfect bandana.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4680084769eeb3074d26ca82416286d7d5ebd7fe.png"]
Sun Ray House Item[p align="-webkit-left"]The popular Sun Ray effect has been turned into a glowing house item. It’s available now in the Premium Housing Item shop for 500 Dragon Crystals, letting you brighten up your home with radiant flair.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c17981e615814c76bbcc5fc34e0ea4615facfefc.png"]
Big Spender Rewards[p align="-webkit-left"]Players who earned the original Sir Sanrick the Fast statue before the price drop are getting something extra. Xero created upgraded versions of the statue with stylish new effects to honor their effort.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e81e1a947d32a51beb999c6da3fadced38c390d8.png"]
Limited Time Shop Update[p align="-webkit-left"]Two new dragon-inspired swords, the Amethystwing's Sovereign and Sapphirewing's Sovereign, are now in the limited-time shop for 1000 Dragon Crystals each. These will become legacy weapons once they leave the shop after this week.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa753f2476ab4a4d05f4b37ad5e0422b11f9a354.jpg"]
Boss and Economy Changes[p align="-webkit-left"]Level 53 bosses now drop much more gold, making fights against enemies like Serpnaut and Sir Arthur Lanceler more rewarding. To balance the economy, new Gold Boosts have been removed, ensuring gold doesn’t become a pay-to-win shortcut. As a bonus, Invisible Items are now purchasable starting at level 1.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7f2a250ba3209d502ae3172e4f24561e17e06a80.jpg"]Last Week: Bundles, Blades, & Booty Ahoy[p align="start"]We're celebrating Talk Like a Pirate Day with the return of Gunpowder Mary and her past treasure troves! For the first time ever, old TLaPD Collections (now called Bundles) are back, and once unlocked, they’re available Account-Wide for all your characters. On top of that, purchased Emotes are now Account-Wide too -- buy 'em once and your entire crew can dance, cheer, or meme together! Quest-earned Emotes stay character-locked, but your purchased flair is shared across the board. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5bd87b9fd53a8712edfae098b61701b453658fce.jpg"]Bravewing's Sovereign Promo Item[p align="-webkit-left"]September’s promo item is the Bravewing's Sovereign, earned with any purchase such as Dragon Crystals, Guardian packages, or the Starter Bundle. Guardians unlock the Jadewing’s Sovereign variant and a display house item to show off their strength. This exclusive reward disappears when the month ends.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a14d4ab3a25345d7b78e6a143ae7a68e636ff6a0.jpg"]Thank you and... next![p align="start"]🎮 Want to help play test new game features? Join the PTR!

🏰 Battleon revamp

🎃 Mogloween!

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Talk Like a Pirate Day Bundles arrrr here!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7f2a250ba3209d502ae3172e4f24561e17e06a80.jpg"]Bundles, Blades, & Booty Ahoy[p align="start"]Ahoy, salty sea dogs ‘nd landlubbers! Time to raise the Jolly Roger, fer Gunpowder Marybe makin’ landfall in Battleon! Aye, and this here scallywag brought back all her fine Talk Like a Pirate Day Bundles o’ yore. 
[p align="start"]But this year, it be no ordinary haul — nay, fer we’ve made a grand change that players have been askin’ for: BRING BACK PAST ITEMS! The AQ3D Crew is bringing back previous seasonal Collections — now called Bundles — starting with previous TLaPD booty.
[p align="start"]And thanks to our shiny new Character Slots, these TLaPD Bundles are unlocked Account-Wide, meanin’ once ye buy a Bundle once, it will be unlocked on all your charactersacross yer account. Aye, ye heard true, matey: 1 purchase = all characters in ye crew get to pillage in style.
[p align="start"]Now, if ye already purchased a TLaPD Bundle in past years, no need worry about diggin’ through old loot! Weconverted all yer previously claimed Collections into Account-Widegoodness too! Check out the Shops Menu, where yer unlocked Bundles be sittin’ nice and tidy. We’ll keep updatin’ seasonal Bundles fer all the big events yet to come, so keep yer spyglass polished and yer ears open fer the call of Adventure. Quest. 3D! Yaaarrr!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d6366ab00a11ee5201ef0df6f9a2866b8465f3ad.jpg"]
Emotes for Everyone[p align="start"]Emotions are universal, and now so are your Emotes! Starting this week, all purchased Emotes are officially Account-Wide. That means if you pick up a dance, cheer, or silly expression in one shop, you’ll be able to use that same Emote across all your characters forever. No more needing to repurchase or wishing your alt could Twerk… Emotes are unlocked for your entire crew!
[p align="start"]You can find Emotes scattered across Lore, from special shops to the dedicated Emotes Shop in the Shops Menu. Collect them to build up your perfect set of in-battle celebrations or roleplay shenanigans with your guild. Just keep in mind that Emotes earned from completing quests will remain tied to the character who earned them… because hey, sometimes you gotta work for that special flair.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5bd87b9fd53a8712edfae098b61701b453658fce.jpg"]
Promo + Limited Time Loot[p align="start"]For all you shiny-obsessed heroes out there (me being one of them), we’ve got brand new loot to sink your teeth into. The Winged Sovereign Blades — our latest Promo Item — is available with any upgrade, including DC packages and Guardian.
[p align="start"]And that’s not all! Sail into the Limited Time Shop in the Shops Menu to discover the brand-new Gold Smasher and Silver Masher weapons. Bold, brash, and built to bash, these smashers are only here for only 1 week, so grab them while you can. Shiny & smashy makes monsters go splashy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9bc847573b2401bac7b0de5cd5ae75977d69aecb.jpg"]
Moving Forward[p align="start"]Behind the scenes, our team has been steering AQ3D towards a brighter and more rewarding future. With so many exciting changes and improvements rolling out, it’s important we revisit older parts of the game to make sure they align with the new vision we’re sailing toward. Our goal has always been to make the world of Lore as fun, meaningful, and rewarding as possible for all players, and that sometimes means rebalancing or refreshing existing content.
[p align="start"]Recently, we took a fresh look at the Nulgath Saga, making adjustments to better balance the experience and bring it in line with said goals. We’ve also got our eyes on items like Blaze’s Bapper, reviewing their impact on gameplay to make sure everything stays fair and fun. As always, we’ll keep monitoring the state of the game, making improvements, and addressing issues whenever needed. 
[p align="start"]Adventure never stands still, and neither do we!
[p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0135bec1c9f7598de523f781f0847bda20e0ab4e.png"]
Last Chance: 2025 Summer Bundle[p align="start"]With the introduction of Account-Wide Bundles, we’re extending the Summer Collection sale for 1 more week! This is your final chance to soak up the sun — and 80% savings — with the 2025 Summer Bundle. This sizzling set of 39 items unlocks Account-Wide, so all of your characters can chill in those warm summer nights knights. Don’t miss the chance to add this exclusive Bundle to your collection before it sails into the sunset. 
[p align="start"]Get the Summer Bundle from:

Game News → 2025 Summer Collection Promo → Unlock the Collection

notes.title: 100+ Trobbles, Dwarves, and sneak a peek at secrets & behind the scenes things
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c0445bb6782a9190040a9e7ef82bbe0466423a0f.png
Trobblemania, Blade of Awe preview, and sneak peeks!
Prepare for Trobble, pure chaos, and fun! Trobbles are these adorable little guys that drop from just about anything you defeat in the game. Whether you're farming, questing, or just vibing in a dungeon — you're probably getting Trobbles. Some are tied to events or specific drops, but most are just chillin in global loot. Over 100 to find! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/598210c368d99eaeaef610a422fe86aeb42caef6.jpg
Blade of Awe Preview
The Blade of Awe is in development by Dage the Evil, with both visual and story elements being carefully planned. The story behind the weapon ties into the upcoming main campaign update, with Dage adding some secret, spoiler-y flair. The design reflects the classic Artix style and nods to past games, matching well with Sanrick's armor for those who love coordinated looks. Details on how to obtain the Blade are being kept hush hush for now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e6a435baa2a8c4c2d47e7cc91d1f63b186689217.jpg
How to (not) Make Yulgar's Inn
Yergen originally designed a stunning new map for Yulgar’s Inn, but it ended up feeling a bit too modern for Battleon’s cozy, small-town vibe. So, the map’s getting repurposed as a Port Town (perfect fit!), while Yulgar’s Inn keeps its classic structure with some fresh visual updates and new additions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/124507bebb0a740876bcddc8fc60425abf4993b9.jpg
This includes an exterior blacksmithing area that reflects Yulgar’s role, plus a reworked interior with color-coded zones—main floor, balcony and stairs, bedrooms, and even a bathroom. The goal is to modernize the space without losing its original charm. Did we nail it?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/20b9edb85493342c8844eabbe05a82ee225a4d29.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4db7332ed623d2a7137b63380741ea5e94cd914e.jpg
Dwarves!
We’re working on DWARVES! Yep, a brand-new race with their own homeland and lore. Clarion pitched the idea of antlers and horns on them (because why not?), and Dage took that and ran. The concepts are looking so cool, but I can’t spill much yet—story secrets and all that jazz. Just know it’s gonna add some major variety to Lore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/314fef34d9134c0e78415e01bfd69fd1b1e9feb0.jpg
Clarion Has a Beard
Clarion has a beard... for maybe a week? Why? Because Oishii asked me if we were ready to roll the release to live, or if I needed to add anything else, and I thought it'd be funny to say "WAIT HOLD ON I NEED TO ADD SOMETHING DON'T ROLL YET!". So here we are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9d09dcdac63e6f333918230996d7d2b39c15e8a5.jpg
Moglin Maker
Remember how we were revamping Moglins? WELL—we’re also making them customizable like human NPCs! That means clothes, weapons, and all sorts of cute outfits. We really want non-human characters to shine just as much as the humans in Lore. It’s still a work-in-progress, but I can already tell we’re gonna fall in love with some brand-new moglin heroes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/63af21e184a0be5f374fe287cfcde97ad733b490.jpg
Forging Heroes
We’ve got BIG characters coming for the story relaunch, and it’s so fun watching them evolve from “words on a doc” to full 3D models. We’ve revealed 3 of them so far—there are 2 more mystery NPCs in the group, so stay tuned. Can’t say much yet (spoilers and all that), but they’re super important to the new story direction. Trust me, you’re gonna want to meet them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d05287646dc9eb8385c9f7563b4537ea51d6e737.png
Last Week's Release
Mother’s Day at Yulgar’s, Spring Flowers drop off monsters, Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon variants, and bonus Treasure Chest rewards for our amazing Guardians. https://aq3d.com/news/spring-into-celebration-2025/ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/377251bcccceaf14190d3aa5f79c04825a915056.jpg
Star Lores Swag @ HeroMart
Get the Star Lores Episode IV "A New Hype" Poster, now available at HeroMart! New bonus in-game reward too for AQ3D. Check it out at https://heromart.com/products/starlores-a-new-hype-poster

New Promo Items: Azure and Veridian Star Scythes
The Azure Star Scythe will be awarded to any player who makes an upgrade purchase during the month of May. This includes not only Dragon Crystals but also any Guardian package and the Starter Bundle. Guardians will receive a variant known as the Veridian Star Scythe at no additional cost. In addition to both weapons, each promo will come with an additional house item to hang your fancy weapon off in your home. Simply head over to the Guardian Tower and speak to Fortes after finishing your Guardian initiation. A friendly reminder that all Dragon Crystal packages have a 50% bonus on them!

notes.title: 🌸 Mother's Day, Dragon Pets & TFs, and much more
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/14ecf2a607342eb55c4eb99b978f749941c82c34.jpg
Mother's Day Questline, Spring Flowers, and More
Just in time for Mother's Day, a new questline has arrived in Battleon! Visit Yulgar inside the Inn—he’s planning a sweet surprise for Aria and needs your help. While the story’s details are hush-hush to avoid spoilers, there's a special reward waiting at the end, and Spring flower drops are back for house decorating!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a515d52922b27c204bcd51237216874b3c16367b.jpg
Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon Heroic Essence
The Blue-Eyed Soul Dragon, originally released as a free early-game Travel Form, now has new variants! These include armored and ghostly versions, obtainable through Heroic Essence from level 50 endgame bosses. Visit Sir Arthur Lanceler to exchange your essence for pets or Travel Forms—intended as long-term, earnable rewards just for playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c34c2f6b49568d2ce18ac3a919a983fe0fd7f1c6.jpg
Treasure Chest Rewards Bonus Guardians
We’re adding bonus features to Treasure Chest rewards, starting with Guardian-exclusive weapon displays! If you own the Void Star Scythe, you can now claim a matching House Display item from the new Guardian Golem Gift Distributor NPC in Battleon. This system will eventually be automated and retroactively applied to older items too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/501206d7c24b0b5b5336c90e6d168df7300080f9.jpg
Moglin Magic
Behind the scenes, we’ve been cooking up tech for AQ3D’s massive main story revamp—including custom Moglins! Thanks to Xero and Astra, Moglins will soon have changeable colors, clothing, and models that match modern NPC quality (like Kajits). It’s still a work in progress, but we’re excited to show off a hilariously cursed Moglin in pants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c5fe990a588dadf40b239b6a62478a163ad79595.jpg
Critters are Coming!
Astra is also breathing life into Lore by designing critters like cats, dogs, bunnies, and more! These creatures will populate the world and make it feel more alive and immersive. You may have already seen some in the intro maps, but there’s plenty more to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f3e222393da013c36724ce2b3bc62c6b4a8972e9.jpg
Improving the Little Things
This one’s small, but a big win for devs: our quest-building tools just got a major upgrade! Thanks to Spider’s spawn editor and Zhoom’s help, NPCs now behave better when moved mid-questline. No more weird APOP glitches when characters shift locations—this fix made the Wiggly Whompa release a lot smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7425f60a4e3ddd564effeca70f1726f821422657.jpg
Void Star Scythe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0176486295349a1f14fc5adc294c443383b51528.jpg
A New Start
We’ve been hard at work revamping AdventureQuest 3D over the last year. The team and I are so excited for you to get your hands on the revamped introduction to AdventureQuest 3D, which will start with your adventures in Mossmere that will kick off the new main story for AdventureQuest 3D. All of the gameplay and system changes we’ve been making to AdventureQuest 3D have truly been leading up to this - a brand new main campaign with exciting new characters and mysteries to uncover. All built upon the foundation we’ve been forging with systems like Heroic Skills and Spellforged gear. We look forward to you all questing through Mossmere and arriving at the new version of Battleon, where your journey through Lore will truly begin. And don’t worry… as a thank you for partaking in playing through our new beginning. There will be a reward… a platinum promise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/889bcffc7b16caf9b9eacb3bc4aaa22d81a21a6b.jpg
New Battleon?
We’re hard at work finishing up Mossmere, but development on AdventureQuest 3D truly never ends. Mossmere was designed to be part of the Greenguard region, so a lot of the assets we’ve been building will be used to revamp the whole of Greenguard, including Battleon, as you can see in the picture above. While still very early, things are progressing fast!

A lot of players have been asking me directly what will happen to the current Battleon… Nothing! Well, for the most part. Current Battleon will remain accessible as a legacy map and be left untouched, save for a portal to the current Battleon. That way, no queststrings will be broken and those who just wanna hang out in Battleon can still do so! So as we build the new story, know that you will still be able to play through all that is currently in the game. I think the only thing we really wanna change is maybe removing the portal cutscenes… At least the ones that are there, that is.

Once we finish Battleon, this will lead us into the new Greenguard that will surround Battleon and Mossmere. While chapter 1 of our new story will take place in Greenguard that doesn’t mean Chapter 2 will be a revamped Heartwood. In fact, right now we’ve been leaning towards something more… coastal…

As I have more info to share, I’ll keep you posted here in the Design Notes, really hoping to return to a more casual and fun design notes style. The kind I grew up reading as a player when I was younger. Thank you for taking the time to read this. Words really can’t describe how excited I am about moving forward with this story we’re cookin!

🧝‍♀️ Readying for (Re)Launch!
AdventureQuest 3D's revamped intro and main story relaunch are nearly here, kicking off with a mysterious new job from a client named Solestia. What starts as a simple escort mission quickly takes a magical turn when a shimmering portal opens before you. Stepping through it leads you to Mossmere—a peaceful mining village nestled deep within Greenguard, and the beginning of a much bigger journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/2dca133e3e3e9342cfa471d7494de7fae0de1d8d.jpg
🌿 Welcome to Mossmere
Mossmere is a secluded, serene village built into the rocky terrain of Greenguard, protected by nature itself. You arrive there alongside Solestia, unaware of the secrets about to unfold. What you uncover here will tie your fate to Lore’s—and test the strength of your hero’s heart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7557e9ca17d45d4649580098dc8298c0ca28231e.jpg
🗺️ What Comes After Mossmere
Mossmere marks the beginning of AQ3D's new storytelling approach, with each saga expanding a region week by week. Future content will include a redesigned Battleon and an expanded Greenguard. Every release—from big quests to side missions—will help deepen the world and bring each zone to life.

Alongside it, new villages and towns like Amityvale (for Doomwood) and eventually Swordhaven are in the works. These hubs will be central to their regions and packed with story and exploration content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3c0dd2e6842010b74cc1d0204dfe5a931c97afb.jpg
🙏 Closing Thoughts
Everything—from gameplay updates to world-building—has been laying the groundwork for AQ3D’s biggest evolution yet. This is more than just a facelift; it’s a rebirth of the entire game experience. We can’t wait for you to dive into everything we’ve been working so hard to bring to life.

notes.title: 🐺 Heroic Skills are finally here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4acbfe8590ce375255b3b5bc094ac0f3aec0e617.png
Heroic Skills are here!
The wait is over—the Heroic Skill system is complete and ready to shape the future of AdventureQuest 3D!

For those unfamiliar, Heroic Skills have been in development ever since we overhauled the Skill System back in November 2024. As a quick refresher, AdventureQuest 3D’s skills now fall into distinct classifications, offering more depth and customization for your hero.

Get ready to experience a whole new level of combat!

Class Skills: Core abilities that come with your class by default.

Cross Skills: Special Rank 10 skills that can be used across all classes.

Base Skills: Fundamental utility skills designed for general use.

PVP Skills: Combat abilities specifically for PVP, which can only be equipped in the Battle Hall.

Heroic Skills: Earned through gold purchases, drops, or quest rewards, these skills let you further personalize your playstyle.

Alongside the updates to skill functionality, we’ve expanded the item bar to support multiple Cross, Base, PVP, and the upcoming Heroic Skills. This allows you to equip up to two extra skills, giving you more ways to customize your hero’s playstyle.

With the launch of Heroic Skills, we’re also extending the action bar—now letting you select up to three skills of your choice for even greater flexibility in battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/0ae43b2697f8f70acf97234496fbaae22cd7397f.jpg
Summon Werewolf Centurion
The first Heroic Skill introduced in AdventureQuest 3D is Summon Werewolf Centurion! This marks the fulfillment of a long-standing promise as we continue working toward highly requested features like mounts. 

The Ticket for Your Own Werewolf Centurion was originally added during the Darkovia saga but never served a real purpose—until now. We wanted to do right by the players who worked hard to obtain it, and turning it into a Heroic Skill felt like the perfect way to bring it to life. Now, you can summon your very own Werewolf Centurion in battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3f810d0490dc785d33dea6cba8e5e27b5b15953.jpg
Flash of Light
The second Heroic Skill to join AdventureQuest 3D, Flash of Light, pushes us further toward our goal—giving players more freedom to shape their gameplay and allowing classes to take on multiple roles.

This skill serves as a healing ability, enabling more classes to enhance their sustainability or specialize in group support. As we continue rolling out new Heroic Skills, you’ll gain even more ways to customize your playstyle, especially when combined with Base Skills, Cross Skills, and Spellforged equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1e475ec84f740eb10121c22596bfb7bb5d8cb960.jpg
Heroic Rewards
A new reward system is arriving this week: Heroic Essence! You might be wondering, "Clarion, what’s Heroic Essence?" To which I’d respond, "I have no idea how we’re conversing through a blog post, but hey, that’s a little unsettling!" Then I’d explain—Heroic Essence is designed to grant you extra rewards for battling end-game bosses.

This essence drops at a guaranteed 100% rate from current end-game bosses with high-value loot. Gather enough, and you can visit Sir Arthur Lanceler in his tomb to trade them for unique variants of that boss’s weapon. This system is intended as a long-term reward for the most dedicated players. Moving forward, each major boss will have an essence tied to their gear variants.

On top of boss-specific essence, you’ll also see a more general “Heroic Essence” dropping from all level 50 bosses. These will come into play later, allowing you to obtain items from a special shop—an extra perk for dedicated boss slayers. This marks the beginning of our effort to make boss fights in AdventureQuest 3D more rewarding.

While this system primarily caters to hardcore players, we have plans to introduce additional features for more casual adventurers in the future. Plus, for a limited time, we’re reducing the essence cost for the first batch of rewards. Once this initial period ends, costs will return to their standard rate. Prepare for battle, and claim your Heroic Essence!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/651175ec585518423bbc4d2fbcb455fc31639fd7.jpg
Final Batch Of Back Item Conversions
The last wave of Back Item to Back Accessory conversions is now complete! After one relentless, sleepless night, every remaining intended Back Item has been transformed into an Accessory. With over 150 fresh conversions, there’s a huge variety of new looks to explore!

Lord Malrick Dreadrunner has made his appearance in the Underworld this dark warrior wields the Sacred Wind much like Sir Sanrick the Swift but has sworn allegiance to Dage’s Undead Legion. notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ee98bdc44949f8d47330193f159c8ae77540519d.jpg
Sir Sanrick, Knight of the Sacred Wind
This week, AdventureQuest 3D welcomes a new NPC that will add a layer to the Daily Boss Zones. Sir Sanrick the Fast, Knight of the Sacred Wind can be found training his speed within the Battleon Scholar district. If you can catch him you’ll be able to ask him how he’s so fast. Turns out it’s a combination of training and his magical armor that is powered by the 7 Order Gemeralds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c3c3661bbba0fa36a2479f985f0197dc644b7247.png
Armaments of the Sacred Wind
Sir Sanrick will explain how to create armor like his using the 7 Order Gemeralds. For those of you who are level 50, you’ll find Sacred Rings now drop within the Daily Boss zones. Once you collect 100 of them you will be able to spar with Sanrick to make an Order Gemerald appear! Upon collecting 7 of them, you will be able to combine their powers to create an Armament of the Sacred Wind of your choice.

New Spellforged Boots: Greaves of the Sacred Wind
While all of the Armaments of the Sacred Wind are level 50 Epic quality gear the boots specifically are Spellforged. Their effect? 25% chance on hit to gain a 60% movement speed for 5 seconds. Hopefully, you enjoy zooming through the battlefield!

While the Frozen Doom Weapon Mini Collection has left there is still a chance to buy them individually this week before they leave.

No date to confirm yet, however, we will be working on disabling Spellforged effects for scaled PVP with the goal of possibly introducing an unscaled PVP mode at a later date.

The ShadowReaper of Doom has received a powerful new upgrade! This upgrade grants it a Spellforged effect and brings it up to level 50, making it even more formidable in battle.

Spellforged - Doomsunder: 25% chance to do 25% damage and -10% armor for 4 sec to enemy

Spellforged Passive - DOOOOM!: +10% to Attack -20% to Max HP

The Necrotic Staff of Doom also gets a new upgrade, giving it a Spellforged effect and bringing it up to level 50. Additionally, the model of the Necrotic Staff of Doom at max level has been updated to align with the newer Doom Weapons.

Spellforged Passive - DOOOOM!: +10% to Attack -20% to Max HP

notes.title: 🎉 New Skill System, Action Bar, and Quickstep Dash!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/386a125b4988371e0dcb2eb5a1157b927b2c2156.png
Hotbar Revamp & a late Steam update because the images were not loading in the backend of Steam 🤷‍♀️
The feature announced a few weeks ago has finally made its grand entrance into AdventureQuest 3D. What started off as a way to equip two Cross Skills has evolved into something a lot bigger… Let’s get into it! (This release was on Thursday, November 14, 2024, just fyi) 

How Skills Work
First off, Skills have been revamped to fit into different categories. We’ll start with the most basic skill type and most likely the first kind of skill you’ll use in the whole game, Class Skills. Class Skills are skills the skills that are built into your class. These cannot be changed and are the basic blueprint of how your character plays. Second, we have Cross Skills. Cross Skills are those neat abilities you unlock when you reach rank 10 with a class and can’t slot into any other class you like letting you customize the way you play ever so slightly. Now, here is where we start talking about NEW things. The first big change is we’ve added a brand new type of skill, these are known as Base Skills. Base Skills are a baseline set of abilities that every character will start with, You might recognize them as these were originally all PVP except for Quickstep. Base Skills are mostly focused on utility and will allow us to design encounters with the knowledge players have these options available to them to overcome specific challenges. The penultimate type of skill in the game is PVP Skills. PVP Skills can only be equipped while in the Battle Hall (/join PVPLobby). These skills as the name suggests only work in PVP and are oriented around that. Finally, the last skill category we’ve made is Heroic Skills… Currently, there is no way to access Heroic Skills, however, once we release them I think they have the chance to be one of the most exciting new features in AdventureQuest 3D. Heroic Skills will be obtainable through all different means. From questing to buying from shop vendors with gold, or even from powerful bosses! These skills will allow you to open up what your character can do providing you the ability to heal yourself or party members. Shoot out shadow magic to cause a debuff or even call down lightning on your enemies. Essentially, Heroic Skill can be anything! With this new skill type, you will be able to really make your Hero YOUR hero.

More Slots!
None of this would really matter if we only had one slot to work with like we did with Cross Skills. But, we’ve changed this. The hotbar has been completely revamped to allow skills of all types to be slotted into them. While this week we are launching with 2 available hotbar slots as we receive feedback we can open it up and tweak things to have all additional hotbar slots open to customize with what ever Item or Skill you like.

So Let’s Recap!
Class Skills: The Skills baked into your class.
Cross Skills: The Rank 10 Skill you unlock that works across all classes.
Base Skills: Skills based around basic utility.
PVP Skills: Skills usable in PVP. Must be in the Battle Hall to equip them.
Heroic Skills: Skills you can buy, get as a drop or quest reward. Used to customize your playstyle further.
Essentially, you are building a house! (No, not player housing, we already have that!) The Class is your foundation but the walls and furniture, everything around it that makes it YOUR house are the Cross Skills, Base Skills, and Heroic Skills you choose to make your house… well, YOUR house. Except it’s not a house it’s the Hero who will save all of Lore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e96cc05fe42a49fa470fd602670360ecda193e54.pngThe Bone Inspector
A new questline has been added to the Isle of the Dead for heroes close to the start of their journey through lore. The Goal of this questline is the smooth over some gearing pains in the early game.

The Legion Dragon Ultra Greatsword and the Knight's Dragon Ultra Greatsword can be acquired from an Emperor's Chest, Warlord's Chest, or Soldier's Chest. Good luck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/617fe425b92b3191c7ae928233ab0dccff6209cf.jpg
New Promo Item: Ancient Dragon Ultra Greatsword
This November, wield legendary strength with the Ancient Dragon Ultra Greatsword – a weapon forged in dragon fire and brimming with power! Secure this mighty blade when you purchase any package in the Upgrade Shop. Select packs now come with 50% extra Dragon Crystals too, which I *know* you’re gonna need for the upcoming holiday season! Wanna snag an even greater greatsword? Go Guardian to unlock the exclusive Guardian Dragon Ultra Greatsword as an added bonus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1c2860cacd7658c4456c7e3944d8c06a92e148f9.jpg
Thank you and... next!
🏆 Over 200 amazingly eerie entires poured into the Screamshot Contest! We are thrilled to award 40+ players with prizes who showcased their creativity and frightful fun in so many wicked ways. Check 'em out at https://aq3d.com/news/2024-screamshot-contest-winners/
🎃 Our players really 'squashed' the competition in our Artix Pumpkin Carving Contest! Feast your eyes at https://aq3d.com/news/artix-pumpkin-carving-contest-winners-2024/ 
✨ Guild Spotlight next week! Do you want the chance to have your Guild featured on the Design Notes? Enter your guild at https://aq3d.com/posts/adventurequest-guild-spotlight-series/
🌈 Endless colors coming for skin, hair, beard, lips, and stache! No longer will you be stuck to predefined colors -- find the color palette that's perfect for you.
🎄 Frostval, Friday the 13th, and festive festivities coming soon! 

Closing Thoughts
We want to make AdventureQuest 3D the game we can, with changes like Spellforged Gear and now this change to how skills and the hotbar work I feel more than ever we are on the right path to really opening up AdventureQuest 3D to put player choice at the center of how they play their character. We will continue to look at ways to add depth to the game and help it evolve into the game the players deserve. Thank you for being with us on this journey.

Battle on,
Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

Mystcroft & Moglween Returns

Tis the spooky season of Mogloween,
And the Grave Digger Outfit looks wickedly mean.
Pumpkin Hunters take aim at the moon,
In Corpse Paladin’s armor, you'll hear a dark tune.

In the dead of night, the Suit of Darkness gleams,
While Doctor Bloodstone’s Coat unravels dark schemes.
In the Arachnarette’s Outfit, webs finely spun,
With the Gown of Darkness, the nightmare’s only just begun.

Witch Hunter’s on guard and fully aware,
Harvest Defenders protect crops with care.
Masquerade dresses in colors so bold,
Like Red, Blue, Green, and of course Gold.

The Haunting Wraith Robes drift in the mist,
And Princess Vampina’s Dress is hard to resist.
Gourdian Knights guard the Pumpkin Lord’s flair,
Iron Bat Armors soar through the air.

The Pumpkinmancer’s Robes cast a cursed spell,
In the Witch Robe, you’ll hear a ghostly bell.
Arachnan spins webs, Headless Horseman does ride,
In Mad Scientist coats, dark secrets abide.

Armed with weapons and capes and helms to behold,
These armors tell tales that will never grow old.
So don spooky outfits and enjoy ghoulish delight,
For the season of Mogloween is such a fun fright.

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Set sail for Pirates vs Ninja war! 🥷
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6c4740cd4f67c13f1cdf6259f201001e1c11aafe.jpg
The Blackthorn Fleet Seek Revenge On The Midori Kage Clan
The winds of war blow once again across Lore. A tale of revenge and duty is about to unfold. The Blackthorn Fleet, a group of fierce pirates led by Captain Mordred Blackthorn, demands the head of Master Kurohane, the leader of the Midori Kage ninja clan, to avenge the death of Mordred’s only son, Arthur Blackthorn. With tensions higher than ever, a mysterious voice calls to Mordred, offering a chance to avenge his son by summoning him to the Island of Titans with promises of power. Unbeknownst to him, Ninja Master Kurohane is also heeding a similar call, one that warns of a calamity threatening his clan but offers a way to prevent it. It’s time to pick a side, brave hero of Lore. Travel to the Island of Titans and fight for the cause you believe in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/130f3ca0975828580ac791a9d333ecac42ddd90e.jpg
The Blackthorn Fleet
The Blackthorn Fleet is a formidable group of pirates feared by the people of Lolosia. They believe in a life of freedom, unshackled by society’s rules, as free as the wind that blows across the ocean. Unfortunately for those around them, this means they steal and do as they please.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4f46b2b950a74b67cdc5b2baca21522b8025b1cf.jpg
The Midori Kage Clan
A secretive ninja clan with a long history, the Midori Kage have outposts across the Mysterious Islands. Over the years, they have accumulated many valuable treasures and relics. The Midori Kage value tradition and honor and do not take kindly to outsiders trespassing in their territory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca2c51e5332f4f7f1845d9dee7d695c8e18b26fd.jpg
War Has Changed
The AdventureQuest 3D war system has been completely revamped. Previously, you had to turn in quests to gain progress for the war meter, with all quests counting for the same amount of progress. Now, you can gain progress for your faction’s war meter through various means. Killing monsters, summoning additional troops, and even repairing structures can all contribute to filling up the meter and can be worth different amounts. Additionally, for this war, we are experimenting with a dual storyline, updating the story of the ongoing conflict weekly, so don’t forget to check back!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a032910ad830353d7e271cf82c765a8abf97ee3a.jpg
Spawn Reinforcements
By completing quests, defeating enemy units, and fishing, you can gather materials to turn in with your faction’s NPCs in exchange for items to spawn the reinforcements of your choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3d651b4e8ae8730c8e9654cf27f366d40807aa39.jpg
Rewards!
As the war meter fills up for your faction, you will be able to earn more rewards, including pets, travel forms, armors, and weapons. This time, the items you can unlock are themed around the specific faction you are fighting for.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e37747ac22a2e6a2772d8ee0ccc6564d58e4cb8c.jpg

Returning Content
With it being Friday the 13th Camp Gonnagetcha has opened up once more! Head on over to Yulgar’s Inn and speak to Dottie, the High Archcounseler to book your trip to Campe Gonnagetcha while it’s still open.

For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Draconic Canons at no extra cost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/878c7072d28cf4fe36e19fdd436c146f9deed43d.jpg
An Evolving Conflict…
Next week, the war continues with an expanding plot unique to both factions. And of course, the Talk Like a Pirate Day collection will arrive! This collection will be themed around the war and feature two new class skins: the Doom Pirate and the Doom Ninja.

Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7a9a1c280ae61d307359b101d6f76e7af09beb45.png
Enter the HATch
A strange… person?... has shown up in the town of Battleon this week. If you head over to the Barber Shop you will find Hatrick, the Man of Hats. Hatrick, as you might guess really enjoys hats. He’s obsessed with them in fact. He travels the land in search of rare hats to add to his hat collection, however. This time he needs your help to obtain a hat. Travel to the Hat Tomb and grab it for him. Obviously, this is a simple task for a hero such as yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7ab416c7d0d62b2b794b588a012adc142fa7b037.png
Collect Hats
Once you’ve helped Hatrick out a little you’ll be able to obtain hats from him and.. Horns? Hat-orns…? Collect Powerful Hat Essence from all monsters in the zones. You can also earn Powerful Hat Essence by running the 3 Daily Quests that Hatrick will have available to help you along the way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bdfabd6c49e5986f2d76cdedf536560e0d34e799.png
Travel Forms and Pets?!
Hatrick also has Travel Forms and Pets?!… They wear hats so no rules are being broken with this theme!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg
Class Balance Changes
In our ongoing effort to tune classes and put more fun and power in the hands of the player, we’ve made some changes to both the Pirate and Ninja classes, giving them some AoE.

 Pirate: Flak Shot is now an AoE
 Ninja: Both Slashing Gale and Fire Strike are now AoEs


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/701d6588631874edfeacf2e82db949eb0711336b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6fa7490f187fb6b1f18bf0abdcf30cd6d89c7160.png
Prepare For War…
Next week the Pirate vs Ninja war begins! We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to create a new war using feedback from the Invasion From the Deep. One of these changes is how the War Meter is progressed. Originally, you would only get a set amount from turning in a quest… Any quest. We’ve worked hard to change that system to allow you to earn varying amounts of progress so harder quests will fill the meter faster. But, it doesn’t stop there! These updates to the war system go beyond allowing different quests to have varying impacts on the war effort. Kills and other actions can now count towards filling up that bar. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

notes.title: 🗺️ Explore a brand new map, uncover Azurecrest secrets, and evolve your Lance!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9ccb97e2fc22f4c42fcd06590cfb57e6a7f3a29b.jpg
Embark to Azurecrest Island
This week players will meet up with Bob-O once again and learn more about the Azurecrest Lance. Travel to a mysterious island that once was a home for both Water Elves and early Lolosian settlers. Uncover it’s dark history and eventually empower your Azurecrest Lance into one of two new powerful Spellforged weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/98abb9455fad9ee1ef681f16b405dfd849d2c6e0.png
Azurecrest Armor
The Azurecrest armor is but one of the rewards you’ll find on your adventures. This statted rare quality gear will be an alternative way to get caught up if you’re feeling a little behind in gearing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1593ad254e19d756c2caa250077fb78c7e9eea5c.jpg
Will you choose Redemption?
One of the two upgrade paths you can choose for the Azurecrest lance is Redemption. This regal weapon has the power to call down lightning dealing high damage to the enemy struck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/083a4b536fd69af6adbbe09e57d21501e041086e.jpg
Or Scorn?
The alternative is Scorn, a loathsome shadowy weapon that drains the life force of your enemies healing you with every strike. The choice is yours to make, but don’t feel too bad you can eventually create the opposite weapon to the one you chose as the boss at the end of the Azurecrest Lance’s storyline has a chance to drop more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/fac1b7bbe99ea2d175ddf3511eaf4541b258bae3.jpg
Primal Orb Pet Update
Last week I released a statement about an error I made in releasing an item that was supposed to be reserved to players who purchased the Primal Orb Pet. As promised we are providing a shop attached to the Primal Orb Pet that will give you access to a Fiend Cape of Nulgath without the requirement of any Lost Fragments of Nulgath. Additionally, I had asked Dage to craft an exclusive version of the game known as the Primal Fiend Cape of Nulgath which will also be in the shop for no additional cost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1577b76aa88a609df490f5fd3e6d24e67374c292.png
What’s Next?
I’m really excited to share some information on what we’ve got cooking. The team is hard at work creating a unique Talk Like a Pirate Day event this year. But, this isn’t your typical Talk Like a Pirate Day affair. As a long-time fan of Artix Entertainment and the original AdventureQuest, I’m super excited to announce we are working on a Pirate vs Ninja War for this year’s Talk Like a Pirate Day. Splinter factions within the two groups have formed and seek to put an end to the opposing side once and for all. However, this desire for destruction has awoken an ancient evil from deep within the Mysterious Isles. A new island emerges from the sea and an unseen voice calls out to the war-hungry leaders of both factions. Whispers of ancient weapons of unparalleled destruction can be theirs, an ultimate solution to their problems… DOOM to the opposing faction.

The Pirate vs Ninja War introduces two new DOOM weapons into AdventureQuest 3D. Along with two new Class Skins. It’s with great pleasure that I announce the Doom Pirate and Doom Ninja, we’ve been working on this stuff in the background for a while now and the team is really excited for you guys to get your hands on this sometime in September.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6532a87f08a89148286dc0a90c258ecc5974cc76.gif
Beyond that…
We’ve begun work on a new Saga about a month ago. I can’t say too much about it yet, but I’d like to show you early progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a58274c663d0d6dac7c0fb80acb2fe414188f38b.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg

Balance Changes
Last week some changes made it to live which, while unintended, served to be pretty exciting. For the most part, the spirit of these changes is fine but essentially Warrior and Mage could endlessly scale, we’ve reigned them in just a bit and will be monitoring the situation moving forward. To make up for the change in Mage’s damage output we’ve increased the AoE on their fireball as compensation. While these changes look big on paper it really took crazy circumstances to pop off with the amount of stacks required to break them.

Warrior Class Changes:
Warrior’s Protection stack cap has been reduced from 9001 to 20
Mage Class Changes:
Mage’s Fire Aspect stack cap has been reduced from 9001 to 20
Mage’s Fire Ball AoE has been increased from 3 to 5
This week we have more than class balance changes, we’ve also shifted scaling in some older maps as we move to rebalance the game.

Scaling Changes:
The 20th Anniversary Maps level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
The Moon level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
Skullpunch Island level scaling cap has been reduced to 20.
Atlantis level scaling cap has been reduced to 20
In our ongoing discussions about AdventureQuest 3D, we’ve focused on the Nulgath content. Over the past year, Nulgath weapons have dominated the game, they’ve been the best-in-slot weapons since their release. However, this dominance has had unintended consequences for the game’s economy and reward system. Players have provided feedback that other rewards don’t feel as valuable because Nulgath items are so powerful. Addressing this issue isn’t straightforward. Simply releasing more items at a slightly higher level won’t solve it, as Nulgath weapons are hard-coded to be exceptionally potent. Unfortunately, this situation isn’t conducive to a healthy MMO reward structure or the game’s long-term health. To improve the game experience, we’re taking action. While this will involve nerfing some existing content, we’re committed to creating a more balanced environment with diverse rewards. In the upcoming patch, we’ll adjust the infusion cap for many weapons. If you’ve already exceeded the default cap, don’t worry, you’ll retain your progress.

Item Changes:
Multiple level 42+ items have had their cap lowered to be in line with similar items. This does not affect items already infused above 42.
Sandstorm Capstones and Infusion Runes are now tagged as Items, this will allow players to sell or destroy them to remove them from their inventories.
Fiendish Capstones and Infusion Runes are no longer obtainable or required; convert your Capstones at Maximus

notes.title: 🎉 Oracle Class is here!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a9934ef7392120674975c09cbab838039ec2fbc8.jpg
Master the mystic Oracle Class
The time has come, heroes! Brace yourselves, for now you can harness the power of the Oracle Class in AdventureQuest 3D! Oracles are the very essence of cosmic might manifested. When you enter the realm of these formidable fate-benders, you’ll master the Time Vortex, Cosmic Shadow, Reset Variance, Threads of Fate, and Cosmic Reverberation. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ddd07976bd3c3007707fd1fc0902561597b03fbe.jpg
Oracle Class Skills and Abilities
With precision skill shots and expansive AoEs, Oracles ensnare and annihilate their foes with their arsenal of abilities.

Auto Attack
Strike repeatedly with bursts of magical energy, overwhelming your enemies with relentless force.

Cosmic Shadow 
Launches a spectral spear of ethereal energy that slices through foes with deadly precision. This ranged attack not only hits its mark but also pierces enemies behind it, inflicting the "Bad Omen" debuff. Bad Omen increases damage taken by the enemy by 5% per stack. 25% is the max stack of Bad Omen.

Reset Variance
Mastering Reset Variance is the hallmark of an Oracle. Launch a Time Vortex, strike from afar with Cosmic Shadow, and when your enemy is near defeat, Reset Variance to unleash another Vortex. Each calculated kill resets your cooldowns, readying you for your next strike. This skill also applies Bad Omen.

Time Vortex
Control the battlefield with a swirling maelstrom of temporal energy. This AoE attack slows reality, rends flesh, and places Bad Omen on all enemies caught within. 

Threads of Fate
Invoke the ultimate power of the Oracle. Threads of Fate cuts the target’s current HP by 50% instantly (5% max against bosses) and descends a full stack of Bad Omen upon them, binding their fate to doom. Use this skill at the beginning of the battle for maximum impact.

Cosmic Reverberation
Channel cosmic power to mark an enemy, healing all allies who strike the marked target. This cross skill is essential for bolstering your team’s endurance.

No matter if they are friend or foe, Oracles are formidable beings who bend fate to their will. Their mastery over cosmic forces makes them unparalleled in battle, weaving devastation and destiny with precision and power. Embrace the arcane, and step into the shoes of an Oracle to wield these otherworldly abilities. BTW, we let our players vote, so Oracle Class has arrived now without its Legendary Armor set. That set will come at a later date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/11be173c00f2731d5acde440671a441d37f8665f.jpg
Meet Lothain, the Oracle Class Trainer
Do you dare control time, shroud your enemies in shadows, and alter the threads of fate itself? Then join the ranks of the Oracle Class and become the newest legend in Lore! 

The cosmos awaits your command… seek out Lothain in Battleon if you are ready to answer the call!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/26f037c37549ec13529f30848b86852078bc33dd.jpg
Paladin Class Revamp
We’re examining adjustments to class mechanics to enhance their overall experience. During my playthrough on stream, I noticed that some classes had downtime or lacked impact. Our goal is to gradually address this by introducing class rebalancing. Ultimately, we want every class to be enjoyable to play!

Paladin Class Changes

 Ardent Virtue: Stacks of Ardent Virtue now refresh the cooldown of Radiant Blade once consumed.
 Holy Shield: The baseline duration of Holy Shield's duration has been altered from 1.5 seconds to 2.0 seconds but the upgraded version has been changed from 3.5 to 5 seconds.

Starting with Paladin we are making some changes to the way Paladin’s Ardent Virtue works. Moving forward, Ardent Virtue will refresh the cooldown of Radiant Blade when consumed. This will offer more uptime on the ability giving you more time to press the fun button, but… It also opens the paladin up to lining up a few stacks of Ardent Virtue and unleashing a barrage of multiple Radiant Blades at once during an armor break to snapshot that damage in that window. This allows the paladin to come up with more strategies! Will you weave in your Radiant Blade strikes between your other cooldowns? Will you save them for an armor break? The choice is yours!

The Ardent Virtue changes are not the only tweaks we made to the paladin class. Holy Shieldnow lasts longer, too! I believe these class changes should solidify the class fantasy of being a heavily armored champion of the light.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c8c671e306a479add68eb203a095cef485e2f497.jpg
Umm… surprise!?
So… While writing these design notes I found out some class changes that had been in testing made it to live by mistake! We will be monitoring how they change the game. 

 Warrior's Whirlwind: Maximum Protection stacks increased from 12 to 9001.
 Rogue's Toxic Surge: Max stack bonus increased from 4 to 8.
 Mage's Fire Ball: Fire Aspect maximum stacks increased from 3 to 9001.
 Healer's Renew: Kinship maximum stacks increased from 40 to 9001.
 Berserker's Battle Fervor: Battle Fervor now makes the Berserker unstoppable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/66586816d0eadc69c7156cdff26adab853a3327c.jpg
Rubber Ducky Hat + House Item
What the duck is that?! Now you can totally ‘wing it’ with the adorably awesome Rubber Ducky Hat! Just look at that wittle wellow birb boi perched perfectly upon your head. Good thing he’s potty trained, huh? To adopt your feathered friend, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, score 50% extra Dragon Crystals, AND as an added bonus, you’ll unlock the Rubber Ducky House Item. For those who get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the exclusive bubble-blowing variant helm!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/14255a56bf8f434917c796f046a53c76ba0db103.jpg
New Contest: Co-Op Sandbox
Unleash your creativity in our Co-Op Sandbox Contest! Team up with friends to build incredible things using the new Multi-Build house feature. The contest runs until Wednesday, June 19, with prizes up to 6,000 Dragon Crystals for the top team. Submit your multi-build masterpieces and you + your team will have a chance of being crowned “Sandbox Supreme.” 
Full contest details here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/aa9878cc562981770d3bee2cde0dfdbea514ad1f.jpg
Artix Summer Postcard Contest
Celebrate the sizzle of summer with our first-ever Artix Summer Postcard Contest, where artists and writers alike can showcase their talents. Create Artix-themed postcards using any art medium and/or write a short fanfic on the back! Artix Points prizes for our winners! Open to all Artix Entertainment players from every Artix game. Contest runs until Sunday, June 30, 2024. Unleash your creativity and let’s make waves this summer! 

Battle on,
Clarion, Artix, Beleen, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Housing Improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/9ef917eff452f0d264ec20cb2257df835c81dd7e.jpg

Revamped playing housing + Multi-build arrive in AdventureQuest 3D
AdventureQuest 3D is introducing two significant housing improvements this week. First, we’re eliminating purchasable housing slots. If you’ve already purchased a house, you can now use it immediately. Additionally, we’ll be providing refunds for any housing slot purchases in the form of Dragon Crystals. We hope this makes getting into building your dream house more simple and straightforward. Beyond that Guardians will get a +1000 House item limit bonus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/cdee5f57e484ee2100f45273231edf64612f1177.jpg
New Function: Multi-Build
The housing improvements don’t stop with the changes to housing slots and guardian bonuses. We’re also introducing Multi-Build! No longer will you be stuck building your home solo. Party up and assign your friends as builders, and work together to create your dream home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c51904e9cabad5eb93693ceb6c2a7f6d6ca66a6f.jpg
BMany Improvements
As mentioned in a previous post, we’re closely monitoring the changes we’ve made to areas where scaling has been removed. Your voices have been heard loud and clear! Now, more skeletons spawn within the dark reaches of the Bone Zone. But skeletons aren’t the only horrors lurking in the deepest corners of the BMany Dimension. Legends speak of powerful BOne versions of familiar faces that roam the graveyard, seeking battle. Who knows what rewards await those who dare to face them? And beyond that, an even more sinister foe lies in wait for any unlucky traveler who crosses its path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/acd3be9f77ba053654681ae8cb4790455959a848.jpg
New Map Interface
The map interface in AdventureQuest 3D has undergone a revamp, accompanied by a stunning new painting depicting the world of Lore. This updated interface now includes clickable nodes that lead to various locations across Lore, providing players with a better sense of the game world.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/f49befe5e5b36702baa913ab2d72d3b79aaa066d.jpg
Week-Long Server Boost!
For one week we will be doing a server boost for 200% XP and 200% Class XP. So! If you’re behind on leveling up or just wanna get some class ranks grinded out take advantage of this week!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/27ab1c4e4a71dd02a173f47658f9a45d15e81ba8.png
Leaving Next Week: The Songs of Pastels
It’s the last chance for our May promo item is the Song of Pastels Aura! To get this ethereal aura, just purchase any package in the upgrade shop, now with 50% extra Dragon Crystals on select packages. For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Fluttering Song of Pastels, an exclusive butterfly-themed variant at no extra cost.

Battle on,

Clarion, Artix, and the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.content:

Greetings, heroes!
This week we journey to Lolosia and begin their quest by speaking to Gunpowder Mary, the Governor of Lolosia. It’s there you’ll be informed of a suspicious character by the name of Bob-O, who prefers to be called “Bob-O Saltiest Seadog in the Sea”. It’s this encounter that will end with you receiving the long-lost Atlantean weapon known as the Azurecrest Lance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/926a6e5bac880a21ef9839d1ebda4aa447406b8e.png
Tip the Scales
We’ve been listening to player feedback and have made the decision to remove level scaling from non-seasonal content in  AdventureQuest 3D. notes.title: The Wandering Light
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/a7fde4d111e3f9acd34e34666c5fe3a100728975.jpg
Follow the Light
Recently arrived in the town of Battleon, Lady Phimion seeks out members affiliated with the Cult of Mortis, a secretive group of death magic practitioners who adhere to the teachings of an enigmatic necromancer whose name is still unknown to even the most experienced undead slayers. Known to those she encounters as ‘The Wandering Light,’ Lady Phimion has taken it upon herself to eradicate this group before they unleash a tide of darkness upon Lore. Join her in cleansing the depths of the Battleon Cemetery before Battleon becomes ground zero of a zombie apocalypse!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/db4ac7dd10e028c63832d114583abf3d3ce0be6b.jpg
Armor of the Wandering Light
For your unwavering dedication and valor in putting an end to this relentless potential undead scourge, a remarkable reward awaits you... the Armor of the Wandering Light. This illustrious armor, steeped in ancient tradition, is not merely a physical protection but also a symbol of your triumph over darkness. To acquire it, you must collect the Motes of Wandering Light for the venerable Lady Phimion, who guards the secrets of its creation. Each mote you offer represents a fragment of your courage and resilience, and as you gather them, the armor’s luminescent glow intensifies, resonating with the very essence of your heroic deeds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ca990da1f459024a4230886043b149694780a797.jpg
Spear of Piercing Light
However, there’s more to the tale. Beyond the initial revelation, it becomes apparent that the blessed spear wielded by Lady Phimion holds a significance that extends beyond mere legend. This formidable weapon, known as Spear of Piercing Light is not only a symbol of her unwavering devotion but also a beacon of hope for those who stand against the encroaching darkness. Its holy glow, fueled by the very essence of the Motes of Wandering Light, grants it unparalleled power. A shining force capable of piercing through the veil of malevolence that shrouds the Cult of Mortis. As Lady Phimion embarks on her quest to thwart their sinister plans, she clings to the spear’s hallowed grip, knowing that its divine purpose is intertwined with the fate of Lore itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/ec251c6908d7a172c5abefab9b837e1e7f80a2b5.jpg
Increasing Housing Slots
Commencing today, adventurers have the opportunity to broaden their housing horizons by securing additional slots for 2,000 Dragon Crystals apiece. These coveted slots offer abundant space for customizing your diverse array of properties throughout the world of Lore. Whether you envision a rustic cabin nestled in the forest, or dare to dream of your personal space base perched upon the moon, these new slots unleash boundless possibilities for players to set their creativity free.

notes.title: A Plea From the Woods
notes.content:

Answer the Voice of the Forest!
In the depths of Heartwood Forest lies a grotto that is home to an enchanted, wise old tree known as the Voice of the Forest, an ancient tree that serves Lore herself. Unfortunately, not all is well. A corrupting force strikes at the very ground we stand on, sending tremors throughout Lore’s soil causing great pain to all who are connected deeply with her… The Voice of the Forest calls out for your help, Hero of Lore! Will you heed its call?

notes.title: Build a Burger Workshop
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/8651237d808ecc72245733e635717e84976ad462.jpg

Build a Burger Workshop

Transform your home into a cheeseburger paradise with Burger Hero Home Franchise! Then dive into pixelated adventures with 8-Bit Travel Forms. Join us for eggstra special Grenwog shenanigans and check out our newest April promo item!
New Housing Items Are on the Menu!
Ladies and gentlemen, gather around! 

Are you starving? Craving that irresistible aroma of sizzling grease and the tantalizing taste of questionable-quality meat? Ah, the culinary thrill of standing in line, your stomach growling, while your inner voice screams, “Maybe I should eat literally anywhere else!” But who needs quality when you can have grease-soaked glory?

Introducing the Burger Hero Home Franchise Experience! 

Picture this: You’re lounging on your couch, remote in hand, and suddenly, like a beacon of caloric hope, Burger Hero materializes in your living room. No more tedious walks to the local joint - Nah, that’s for amateurs! We’re flipping the script. You’re the boss now!

Why settle for mundane home decor when you can transform your abode into a burger paradise? With our exclusive Burger Hero housing items, you’ll be the envy of your neighbors. Imagine the conversations:

Neighbor: “Hey, did you redecorate?” 

You: “Oh, just turned my kitchen into a mini Burger Hero. No biggie.”

Benefits of the Burger Hero Home Franchise:

Zero Commute: Forget the whole transforming into a frogzard and running as fast as you to get to work. Your living room is your office now. Just slide into your slippers and start flipping those pixel patties.

Customize Your Menu: Want a triple-decker bacon Hero Burger for breakfast? Go ahead! It’s your franchise. We won’t judge.

VIP Seating: The best seat in the house? That’s your couch, my friend. No reservations needed.

Employee of the Month: Spoiler alert—it’s you. Every month. Because who’s gonna outperform you in your own home?

Burger Hero Swag: Rock that apron with pride. Bonus points if you wear it while binge-watching cooking shows.

Act now! Be the pioneer of the Burger Hero revolution. Your home, your rules. And remember, folks, “When life gives you housing items, make burgers!” 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/827ff959f308e3cbd1199eee4db39fbc07594800.jpg

8-Bit Travel Forms
Look, I’m gonna level you with here…

You know those snazzy polygons that dance across your screen? Yeah, they’re cool and all, but let me tell you what’s even cooler: PIXELS! Those tiny, square wonders that weave the very fabric of our digital existence. They’re like the building blocks of this 3D Adventure Quest world.

And guess what? These magical pixels aren’t just for show. They’re the secret sauce behind our brand-new Travel Forms! 

“So how do I obtain these new travel forms?” I hear you asking. Head over 8-Bit Clarion Dawnforger in Battleon, and prepare to be amazed. He’s got a collection of these pixelated wonders, and you’ve got options:

Grab the whole set at a sweet discount. It’s like getting a pixelated buffet for your character. Or if you prefer there’s always the à la carte option.

So if you ever wanted to be an 8-Bit Alma running at an above-average speed now’s your chance!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/722a7522b1bdb962b643e38bc7fe3b1871125ee2.jpg

8-Bit Housing
On top of the travel forms, we will also be introducing housing assets from 8-Bit Battleon! So yes, dust off those gamepads and blow into that cartridge because it’s time to reject modernity and embrace tradition! Embrace the NEStalgia and get your 8-bit building materials by talking to 8-Bit Clarion Dawnforger in Battleon!


Grenwog Strikes Back
Hooper claims the Grenwog has returned. You’re not a Grenwog denier, are you? Just outside Battleon, you’ll find Hooper hot on the trail of proving the Grenwog exists! But be warned, hero. The Grenwog (that is totally real) will be ready for a fight! Drop down into the deepest depths of the Grenwog’s Lair. Band together with fellow heroes, set traps, and battle the Grenwog to collect Chocolate Grenwog Eggs to turn in for cool rewards. However, there are alternative ways to obtain those delicious eggs! They have a small chance to drop globally while the event runs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/37fe104eb5c9a9aa83a443db24d327e947c522ab.jpg

Grenwog Treasures
Two new weapons are being added to Hooper’s Grenwog Nest Shop the Eggsecutioner Axe and Eggsassin Daggers. These new tools of destruction match great with the Bunny Berserker set which is also available in the shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/6a8e4d9b8f1fa0af6c3f2bf8ba9e91c1aa5e68e8.jpg

Eggcelent Friends and Foes
On top of NPCs like Piddle the Fool and the Dricken Acolyte returning to Battleon, the Social District will be the stage of the Chicken Cow Invasion. But more exciting than all of that is the arrival of Egglin in Battleon. Help Egglin find his brother Roggbert in Arcangrove to earn Scrambled Eggs that you can redeem for EGGCELENT rewards.

notes.title: A Place to Call Home
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/c9f809d18b88d217cda9997d8d693263d9f3f094.jpg

It’s Time to B.U.I.L.D.!
Exciting news! Housing is making its grand entrance into Adventure Quest 3D this week! Make your way to the Battleon Trade District and have a chat with the B.U.I.L.D. Foreman, Brigitte. She’ll set you on an introductory quest that culminates in you acquiring your very own house! What does this mean for you? Well, as the valiant hero of Lore, you now have a cozy abode to call your own. But wait, there’s more! As a player, this feature grants you the power to customize a delightful slice of Lore. So go forth, decorate, and make your mark on the world!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/df973536951cdbbe91b0dc87de2cc6cfe87a0556.jpg
How does it work?
Once you’ve unlocked your first house, accessing it is a breeze. Simply locate the new housing button in the menu. From there, click on the inviting door icon, and presto! You’ll step into your very own abode. Now that you’re inside your house, it’s time to personalize it with housing items you’ve collected. Don’t fret—you’ll start with a few essential items. Not only can you place these items, but you can also rotate them, adjust their size, and rearrange them to your heart’s content. Here’s the exciting part: objects within your house have collision, which means you can create mini parkour areas or arrange furniture strategically. But how do you acquire new items? I’m glad you asked! Head over to the B.U.I.L.D. Depot in the Battleon Trade District. There, you can purchase housing items using gold from the Basic House Items shop or trade in Wood Planks and Building Bricks at the B.U.I.L.D. House Items shop. And that’s not all! Niall has a Special Furniture Collections button, featuring Legion-themed house items. Some of these treasures require gold, while others demand Dragon Crystals. Now, let’s talk about collections. Instead of buying an entire collection as individual items, you can use the new “Purchase Now” button. Why is this beneficial? Imagine you want multiple copies of a chair from a collection. If you own the collection, you can snag as many chairs as you’d like without any extra cost. So unleash your creativity—build that tower of chairs and tables. That's just the beginning, however. As time goes on we will expand on features and ways to obtain new housing items via quests and drops... In fact, for those who have completed a wing in the Battleon Museum, you'll be able to talk to Danicka Rose to collect a banner for each wing you've filled up with moments!

Additionally, thanks to bug reports from players, we’ve addressed issues where certain monsters were not dropping moments. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!

The Return of the Clover Crusaders
The Clover Crusaders have returned to Lore and are seeking to test their mettle against only the strongest heroes Lore has to offer! You’ll find these emerald-clad knights wandering various zones throughout the game world. Just like last time they drop Clover Leaves which you can trade in at the Battleon Social District for Lucky Day rewards. While you’re there, why not do battle against returning Lucky Day bosses including King Sneed the Clover Conqueror who has a chance to drop a special green variant of the cardboard crown called the Crown of the Clover Conqueror. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1dc50701c99343eeb09852b79a530591c6059263.jpg

notes.title: That Belongs in a Museum!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/74bcdaebfb310ee9ccf26878729c7ef4d4a910f5.png
That’s right! The long-awaited Battleon Museum is opening up to everyone in this week's historic release of Adventure Quest 3D. Head on over to the Scholar District of Battleon and lend a hand to the chronomancer-turned-curator Danicka Rose by helping her fill out the museum’s displays with creatures big and small that you’ve encountered on your many adventures through Lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d7601a80dc7d74c4f5c659796c7fff9170ef7d07.png
Danicka Needs Your Help
While Danicka has grand ambitions to fill the museum with anything and everything of notability that Lore has to offer, she currently has… nothing. That’s where you come in! Talk to Danicka in the museum lobby to begin an introduction quest line that will get you started and have you collecting “Moments” which will be required to create your very first display.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/1f300f8d5ab3c852a855940d8f116f94300034a7.png
What’s a Moment?
You might be asking, “What’s a Moment?” Well, I’m so glad you asked. Moments are a new type of item being added to Adventure Quest 3D this week. They drop off enemies that you’re able to make museum displays of. What’s unique about Moment in comparison to previous item types currently in the game is that Moments are automatically looted and added to the token section of your inventory and don’t take up any bag space. Once you’ve collected enough Moments, don’t forget to head back to the Museum to create a display! (And earn a nice chunk of XP… and maybe a title for completing an exhibit!)

A New Layer of Gameplay
The Museum is intended as our take on a bestiary or monster log and as such will be updated over time to cover monsters across the whole game world. With that in mind, it’s important to state you probably shouldn’t expect to knock this out in a weekend! The museum is meant to be played at your own pace and is more of a complementary layer over existing gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e60cd7002aed86aedacc2774ec76ec7581493ea6.png
The Mythical Blue Cloak
Are you in search of a new fashion piece? The pinnacle of your rare item collection? Just want a cool-looking blue[strike] cape [/strike]CLOAK? Well, if that’s the case head on over to Battleon, and standing just outside Yulgar’s Inn you’ll find Clarion Dawnforger, speak to him and craft your very own best-in-slot cosmetic back item today! (At just the low cost of 5 Blue Capes, what a steal!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/4beda6582affed024eb7251ab0588bebad0a772b.jpg
Tune in to the Adventure Quest 3D Dev Stream
Ready yourselves, fellow heroes of Lore! For the last few weeks, I’ve been streaming on the Artix Entertainment Twitch Channel. Can you imagine it? Me and my trusty feline sidekicks adventuring and even sometimes questing across the third dimension every weekday at 6 PM EDT. Whether you are a veteran guardian of Lore or a plucky young squire just learning how to whirlwind pull up a seat and join in on the adventure!

The 2024 Dage Collection
Last week we released the 2024 Dage Collection featuring a personal favorite design of mine, the Legion Necromancer. That collection is still available for purchase so if you like Dage’s Legion swing on by to Battleon and talk to the Legion Necromancer to have a look at the collection!

For those that get one of the Guardian upgrade packages, you will also get the Spectral Wings of the Astral Veil, a ghostly variant that is only for Guardians!

notes.title: A Vampire Hunter Mystery!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/d3055a6f4dfa0eab82da1d8f2db5978f5059c99d.png

 Join us in-game and battle evil for honor, glory, and the ShadowSunder Blade.


Greetings, Hero! A new mission has emerged from the shadows, beckoning you to a tale of mystery and sorrow. In every main saga zone, a new NPC awaits with a shop filled with gear tailored to your level. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/44e1a33b4873f267c86461544ca61d636e8f073a.png
Additionally, we've supercharged the XP from questing in the early zones of the main story, and a week long  gold boost to boot! Let’s dive into the details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/7dffaac79dd9e23e1c9bdcedcab766fbb7e88f7a.png

  A new Adventure/Quest: A Shadow of One's Self

Embark on a poignant journey in "Shadow of One's Self." A woman’s lover has vanished into the night, leaving only silence and mystery in his wake. She needs your help to uncover the truth of his fate. Can you solve the mystery and bring her closure? During the Darkovia saga, seek out Altaria in Boog's Tavern to begin the quest. 

You will be rewarded with...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/459af10eb13841b30a2da969b7de339de823fe62.png
Shadowsunder, a blade that gleams with the promise of resolve and strength.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/5680d4f385398e96dbbcd77e64da2cd0a17425e7.jpg

  This new adventure unlocks half way through the Darkovia Saga.

You can play this new story adventure once you have completed the vampire & werewolf fueled Darkovia Saga. If you have not played through the Darkovia Saga yet, then prepare to step into the war between the Vampires and the Werewolves as both sides attempt to fulfill the prophecy of the Blood Moon. To begin or continue this level 18+ saga (That is level, not age.... although Safiria's dress really is something... the new quest is level 21. Which makes sense. It does start in a tavern after all.)  Open your adventure menu and go to Main Story and then Darkovia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/3f3504c4f45a68b2652959cd6374e100ebd07220.png

  Get some gear… Justin Case

Players with low level gear have been asking where to get better gear during the main story. Look no further than Justin Case. He is a NPC dedicated to making sure you’re well-equipped for the challenges ahead. Justin's shop offers level-appropriate gear to ease your journey through each of the main saga zones. He is located at the beginning of each of the main saga zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/e06ca6151d994c6205b12303e80a693e388c8281.jpg

  Main Story XP Increase

We increased the XP for main story quests from Doomwood all the way to Ashfall, including dungeon side quests from Greenguard through Shadowskull Tower. These changes are designed to streamline your adventure, making it easier to progress through the main story uninterrupted.

  Lunar New Year is Leaving

The Lunar New Year celebration is drawing to a close, and with it the Lunar New Year shop is now closed, but not to fret, hero!  The Dragon Guardian shop will transition to its new home in the Guardian Tower on Guardian Fortes. Make sure to secure your dragon-themed items before the Year of the Dragon festivities conclude!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/bb7d4d695f13d71dae6ba3d2504edaf36826064e.jpg

  Dage Collection Coming Next Week!

Next week heralds the arrival of the Dage collection, complete with blue flames and skulls. The update will include gifting and a challenging level 45 boss fight. Prepare your gear and rally your allies; epic battles and legendary rewards await.

See you in game and…

  Battle On!

  Your friendly neighborhood AQ3D team

notes.title: The Tailor Scouts Meet the Fashion Police!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26011876/35af913c3357eb77f0fd6bbe29b3145e2d12a890.png

The Best in Fashion!
Join the Tailor Scouts on their mission to retrieve the coveted Mithril Shears. These shears are a magical item that will help Winnie make new, more powerful costumes, taking their style to the next level! However, an encounter with the Fashion Police pokes a hole in their plans and threatens an old friendship. Help the Tailor Scouts stop the Fashion Police and maybe even save an old friend in the process.

Note: You must complete the first quest, “Tailor Scouts” in order to begin this quest, “The Mithril Shears”.

https://aq3d.com/media/7100/defeatfashionpolice.jpg

Defeat the Fashion Police!
When you talk to Winnie in Battleon about The Mithril Shears, she informs you that Tailor Scout Melanie is taking longer than expected to retrieve the coveted magical Mithril Shears from Arcangrove. The mission is simple, find Melanie and help her bring home the shears. However, the Fashion Police show up just in time to snag the Mithril Shears before you can. Help Melanie and the other Tailor Scouts track down the Fashion Police and get back those shears for Winnie! On the way, you just might save an old friend from becoming a fashion victim herself.

https://aq3d.com/media/7099/knowledgeispower-bg.jpg

Knowledge is Power!
Earn these Tailor Academy Uniforms and Shoes as you play! Later, you can craft the Fashion Police outfit as well (and additional Tailor Academy Uniforms), from Winnie’s Tailor Academy Uniforms shop when you complete the Mithril Shears quest.

AQ3D Soundtrack Update
As of this release, all commercial music within AdventureQuest 3D (with the exception of some tracks provided by guest artists) has been removed from the game maps! Jongaar (with some help from Broomtool) has spent many months replacing the soundtracks in the main maps with his own custom music, and is continuing to work on replacing the music in the side story and event maps as well. This is a huge task and will take a long time to get every map filled with new soundtracks. However, this means that our content creators are now free to stream AQ3D with the sound on without fear of their stream being demonetised. So, if you happen to enter a map without a soundtrack playing in the background, that’s not a bug. New music is on the way!

Last Chance!
Carnaval has left the Social District until next year.

Lunar New Year event ends near the end of February.
Heroes Heart Day Collection and related content leaves around March 13th, 2024.

Thank you and… Next!
Next week is the last week of February, which means… Gold Boost! This will be quickly followed by the new March Promo Item, so head to the Upgrade Shop to grab your Crimson Moon Sword before it’s too late.

See you in game and…
Battle On!
