notes.title: UFO Sightings! The truth... is out there O_O
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4ae4de53459d2bd45e07d2cbcb0c70abf97bb018.jpg
UFO travel form and pet now available!
UFO sightings are flooding in! The truth is out there. (Mostly in Gaz and Aria's shops.) The time has come to make first contact... we are NOT alone.

Latest Sightings include...UFO Travel FormUFO PetAlien Juice

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e4754c16b71363c0114d1798c94d4cec4f13babf.jpg
Area 51 Secrets
If you read Cysero's Area 51 design notes post last week and were excited about the possibility of alien-themed items coming to AQ3D... You are not alone! We've got something for all those who believe the truth is out there. The post got such an enthusiastic response (and great item suggestions) that Xero worked quickly to put together these two fun spaceship items for the release! This week was the FULL GAME upgrade to the newer version of Unity which includes 64-bit support for Android devices. This means for the past week the team has been "content locked"-- that is, we were unable to add anything new until after the update went live (which it should be now). So Xero and the team got these in just in time.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/556922b9beed73dbb036e93dac291155bbfbaccf.jpg
To Infinity...!
The Area 51 Flying Saucer travel form moves at light speed. Actually, it moves at 160% movement speed which is standard travel form speed, but that's still pretty quick. You can buy the permanent travel form from Gaz's Black Market Shop for DragonCrystals. Alternatively, questing in Barrow Drop will also let you earn Alien Juice, a consumable potion which turns you into a flying saucer. Barrow Drop is in Barrow Point, located down the path directly right of Robina in Greenguard.

You are the Alien
You can also opt to have a flying saucer companion by purchasing the Area 51 pet from Aria's Pet shop. This seems like a perfect idea for those of you who already have green or blue skin -- or your flying saucer travel form can be the mother ship XD.

Alternate Names for this release
I sorta feel like we need to do an entire Area 51 zone. Maybe in September? O_O 

Here were some of the alternate names for this release.
War of the Cross-Platform WorldsInvasion of the Barbarian SnatchersThe X-.DOCsMIB: Mages in BlackCo-dependance Day2019: A Space OddityBattlefield LoreClose Random Encounters of the 3rd KindChickencowBoys and AliensMoglinTrek: The Next GenerationThe Fifth ElementalAr-moglin-geddonGuardian Dragons of the GalaxyKiller Klawgs from Outer SpaceThe Last Extended for one more week StarfighterTravelformers: Dark Side of the MoglinKevin Spacey Invaders (OK, losing focus here...)Feel free to come up with your own in the comment section on the full post :D

Full post at https://aq3d.com/news/invasion_of_the_avatar_snatchers/

"The parody is out there..."

notes.title: Just released! Arcangrove: The Story of Magic
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0055d05f54752c3585d178dda06469054faac236.jpg

The full Arcangrove Saga has just been released!
Enter the Tower of Magic, and quest through Arcangrove, Unicorn Glen, Ornithon Camp, the Crimson Bog, and forbidden places...

See the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/arcangrove_story_release/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2ca83c9d630c3da44608aacc9755e1c53bfd17c.jpg

Where the Magic Begins
You are finally able to enter the Tower of Magic! It's majestic interior will have you spell-bound.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bf44665e81a71e05a3e038f347a5eb78940c926c.jpg

Travel across Arcangrove Forest to enter the Tower. Talk to Rayst in the Tower to begin the story quest and meet the Archcouncil.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/59ef9782117904f22014fa74318f97ae32178a90.jpg

The ArchCounil of Magic
Here, the post powerful mana users from the different schools of magic gather. Including...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3ae0e3ed2165c43756264a0b03160c54451f75d6.jpg

Archmage Arziir

The Archcouncil is led by Archmage Arziir. You want help finding the weapon powerful enough to defeat Vane (and unlock that second rune) but Arziir is hesitant to share the Tower's knowledge.  He is willing to strike a deal though. Everyone has a problem an intrepid adventurer is willing to solve.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/42842f81d72bfe46845233fd16a101d2c537d499.jpg

Where in LORE is Tyrus Kel?
You need to gather clues to decide where in the world Tyrus Kel may have gone. His last known location is in the Restricted Section of the Library, but... It's restricted. There are no invisibility cloaks to help you in this story, so you're going to have to cut another deal. For some reason, there is no magic solution for dealing with the Tower of Magic.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/86a85b6d6ba26090e17a7604fe4973a72d7e0cc0.jpg

Tyrus Kel, the Heretic
The Archmage Arzzir sends you out to find the Heretic called Tyrus Kel who stole a book from the Restricted Section of the Tower's Library. You will travel to all of the places you got to visit in the preview in this search. But you're not the only one looking for him, and not everyone will be helpful along the way.

 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5e0f0c2cbba6430dcbc6adc38bb916cfe8efc109.jpg

Sindria and Unicorn Glenn
You couldn't talk to them in the preview, and they don't plan on saying much now; but you'll get the information you need. Yes, *they* talk to you and Unicorn Glenn's mean mug isn't just for show.

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c3a2e01575b44c6197799e89f5c62d1ffebd385e.jpg

The Ornithon Camp
Find out why Tyrus Kel spent a lot of time in the Ornithon Camp. You will also have to fight some mushroom men who are much more aggressive than the ones in the Dragon Graveyard. Be careful adventurer.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c4498446e4442eda95c7c392b4ba943ea0674461.jpg

Exvidius
A mage so bad nobody would keep him... Except the Void King himself. He's looking for Tyrus the Heretic too.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b6bce87edcbf3af13485576c52d2652ffed9a624.jpg

Into the Dungeon
Your search will lead you into the Crimson Bog. A new dungeon! You will have to fight through Crimson Circle magi and powerful monsters. This was not part of the preview since it is also a turning point in the story. So enjoy!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/101a64a9ef6fbdebc41259a6e78642e090bff532.jpg

No Spoilers!
We won't divulge the rest of the story. That's up to you to find out. But you will learn about the various other kinds of magic that exist in LORE, even if the Archmagi Council doesn't approve of them. You will also find out the secret that got Tyrus Kel labeled a "Heretic" and cause him to draw the attention of Vane's cronies.

 See the latest news on https://www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Arcangrove "A Preview of Magic"
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/de1c0ab17746c01d64d7b99087196a15d92170f1.jpg
Arcangrove "A preview of magic" Pre-Release
The newest version of AdventureQuest 3D just dropped, and with it... a preview of the magical forest of Arcangrove. Login and explore new areas filled with unicorns, bird-people, and magical treasures.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/67dcd9e0546a0e285d3aa8838c40f85f4ac38ca9.jpg
Rayst the Elder Evoker
Use the travel crystal to get to Arcangrove. Upon entering the magical forest, you will meet Rayst. He is an Elder Evoker. In case you were wondering, his title of Elder Evoker means that he is of the 1st rank of Magi who are allowed access to the Restricted section of the Tower of Magic. When you talk to him, he will give quests to earn pieces of his set.

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d4d97695776a7119193080405faf665a854e189b.jpg
The Tower of Magic
Coming with the release of the full Arcangrove Saga... you will enter the Tower of Magic. This week, you can speak to the Sentinels who guard it. They will give you quests to earn Crescent Wolf Armor.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b0ea6bf09adf2cc8940ad791e35176e598c8fcd2.jpg
Cresent Wolf Armor
The forest of Arcangrove is stalked by arcanwolves. But there is ONE monsterous wolf, that is larger than them all. It is the Crescent Wolf. It is a more powerful wolf inbued with the power of the blue moon. When a cresent wolf falls in battle, a new arcanwolf is chosen to ascend. At this point it receives its crescent blades which it weilds from its mouth. Because... it's a wolf. No hands. We checked. You may have seen Craft the full set by doing the quests from the Sentinels who guard the tower.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/712ac612d0fc98a8ccc15f1bf19a0602fb7bbf17.jpg
Unicorn Glen
It's real! It's really... really real! The magical place from your sister's fairy books. Except you can fight them. You know. For loot.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f8bfd2e0753f1bcfe108fef0784b20e804888019.jpg
The Herbalist Cabin
On the Arcangrove side of the Unicorn Glen border, you can find Vesta the Herbalist at her cabin. Craft 6 new items and ingredients (for quests or for purchase) including Unicorn Dust and Brownie Parts. (Brownie like the dessert? Or brownie like the creature? YES.)

Not much else was divulged about Vesta, so I guess we'll find out together. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a5e0ffa80bdf6cc392365a1bba3cd17bc7b1f07b.jpg
Meet Todd the Derpicorn
Oh the majestic sights you will witness in Unicorn Glen! But none is so... *gulps* articulately animated as Todd the Derp'icon. This beast is officially the toughest monster in the world.

(You may have accidentally experienced Todd the Derpicorn pre-release, thanks to a spoiler event by our new programmer Dagger. Todd was drawn by Dage, animated by Korin, and is pride and joy of the AQ3D team.) 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cf360a945932f5065265525b3b766066fcc6d925.jpg
Maximum Animation
He is "hoofs-down, our most animated monster ever." Dage did the art and Korin did the animation. Together they made a truly derpy monster. Farming Todd the Derpicorn is also required to loot hard-to-find items, but he's very hard to kill (level 31!!!), so get real comfortable with looking at that derp face.
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ce44ecd329cc465aa4d85894a48952f1490956e7.jpg

You might also spot a certain unicorn bro. You know who I mean.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4087d5efc711b8fbb17e998b559566757f6d6df3.jpg
Yet another map!? Find the Ornithon Camp.
"What is an Ornithon?" I (Glisel) asked Cysero. "Birdperson. Like in the bank," he said.

Well, that explains why General Polly is a Guard Parrot. When you talk to Polly, you will find level 27 weapons (with stats!) available, and all created by Thyton. For 25,000 gold each; except for a special craftable weapon called Dark Destiny. Now you have something to do with those millions of gold you've accrued for the past 25+ levels! Let me just say, when Cysero mentioned a chakram, I got very excited. And then I saw the chakram and I'm all giddy. I'll gladly shell out gold for that beauty. The other weapons are beautiful too, but this is my fave.   

The Ornithon Camp itself is filled with Ornithon settlers and large tree houses. I'm not ashamed to say it took me awhile to realize how to get up into those tree houses. Well... maybe a little... but I can't take it back now.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0a8052824cb90b53e3d583a03d6a298d775e9856.jpg

Coming next in the full Arcangrove Saga release!
We hope you enjoy this preview of Arcangrove. It is something to hold you over while we finish the cutscenes and maps. The next Arcangrove Saga release will be the full story release. For all of you LORE lore lovers (see what I did there?).  You will find out the source of LORE's magic. You will be able to enter the Tower of Magic to continue your magic training. Specifically mana-based magic (Because there are other types... like dragon magic and void magic). You will also learn about the Council of Magi who are the governing body of all mana-based magic in the world.

Battle on!

Glisel & Artix (We wrote this one together for you!)

P.S The Moglins are shipping! We have packed 6,000 Moglins so far and about 3,000 of them have been shipped.  Read the post here. 


P.P.S Yes, we put , we put those level 1 starter boots back in the game. But we are not telling you where... >_<

P.P.P.S. We just released a new game, IdleQuest, on the new Artix Entertainment Games Launcher 2.0. The launcher lets you play all of our web based games... and future proofs them.

notes.title: Early Access for Moglomancer has begun
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/243f983dac8d57257e821c54a66212e8c66173c0.jpg

Moglomancer released for early access
Moglomancer is a new class that will be available for all players to earn. It was the big, final stretch goal from the Moglins Kickstarter. If you backed the Moglins Kickstarter, you get early access to the class starting now. If not, you still have time. We are shipping the Moglins now. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0622a01b8171fa1f01316d54e71aca6e39be684d.jpg

Moglomancer Class Skills

It is a really fun class to play, and these new skills are going to add a lot of fun to the game.


Zorbak's Bane
Call upon Zorbak to empower your weapon, dealing heavy damage and strengthening nearby allies. Increases your attack until another Moglin is called.
Twilly's Blessing
    Call upon Twilly to heal all nearby allies. Auto-attacks heal allies and drain mana until another Moglin is called.
Twig's Seal
    Call upon Twig to enchant your weapon, silencing your target. Auto-attacks regenerate mana until another Moglin is called.
Passive: Moglin Reach
    Unlocks at rank 4... increasing the size of all area effect abilities
Ultimate: MOGLIN PUNT
    Rear back and pummel a Moglin through your enemies. Don't worry, they enjoy it. The Moglins, not your enemies.
Cross Skill: Blizzy's Blizzard Blitz
Blizzy's Blizzard Blitz is the the Moglomancer's Cross Skill. Summon Blizzy to slow all enemies nearby.  Once unlocked you can equip this on any class. We will be improving the functionality of this spell next week.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4b190fb7b52376d8fcc82239586dc9977d7ee860.jpg
27,000 Moglins just arrived at our lab
If you have been following my Twitter or Facebook, then you probably saw photos of that truck filled with 27,000 Moglins that showed up at our "Secret Underground Lab". Which... also a secret... is apparently on the second floor XD. The entire dev team went into the sun *gulps* and worked together to unlock the truck and bring the Moglins in. We are, as you guessed, in the early stages of a packing and shipping frenzy this week. It is a pretty big deal. This is the largest order of physical products we have ever shipped out of the lab. We were surprised at how awesome the Moglins turned out. Their colors are perfectly vibrant and they are even better than the prototypes. 

Each Moglin includes a code that unlocks a matching in-game Moglin plush pet in AdventureQuest 3D. Late backers have one final chance to get them with all the Kickstarter rewards. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2eb6187089808d35b592b8e702721342203c68e4.jpg

When will Moglomancer be available for all player's to earn?
The quests to get the full Red Moglomancer set will not be released until the Moglomancer class goes live for all players. Currently it is in early access as promised to the Moglin Kickstarter backers. After the early access period ends, this class will become available for all players to earn along with the quests for the Twilly-themed red Moglomancer armor set. Like our previous early access classes, we expect this to be roughly a month. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cb573f84887f44b7a2f83324ed53d849024830fa.jpg

Coming next: Arcangrove
Next week's major story release is the magical forest of Arcanegrove. It is home to the Tower of Magic. Unlike our previous multi-part Sagas, we are doing Arcangrove story in a single release. Hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: 1 vs 1 Duels are LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a50cdf675076edeb92f6456c34d4331e0bbdf45e.jpg

1 vs 1 PvP is now live! Battle players anywhere in the world.
Town has come alive with players dueling. As you read this, a bar fight is breaking out in Yulgars. It's not perfect... but man is it exciting to watch and do! Come give it a try.
https://aq3d.com/news/duels_live/ 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0b33a84c17a81011982378483605bcaa8cdc8f07.jpg

How to Duel
Target a player and click on their nameplate.... there is now an option to duel! Oh, be sure to turn on duel invites in the options. We disabled it by default because... well, you know why X_X

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7ec7dea5a736f79f48daddf45ec6f5d1f34e6d6c.jpg

Dueling 101: Get Gud or get Wrecked

Bring potions, food, and buffs... anything goes. Duels are lawless and very dependent on your gear and stats. Read your opponent and choose your class wisely. There are many strategies to win, and many ways to maximize your attack and defense.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d473b7cb9d6ba38d327428551e9cd34f9439fb4f.jpg

Duel with Honor
"Why is everyone suddenly trying to duel me", says the player named Honor.
This first release of PvP dueling is super fun, but there are still a ton of things we need to improve. For example, it turns out spectators can heal... anyone. (Whoops). Please duel (and spectate) with honor and respect. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/12f4b9d8b7b3a594ecffc59fc2f904c676027d2a.jpg
Keeping Classy!
Many players say the classes Pirate, Ninja, and Mage are currently kings of the battlefield. Well, some players might argue that Necromancer, Paladin, and Rogue are beastly if played correctly too. While we will be making some tweaks, not every class is intended to be for PvP. Experiment with different classes and share your findings with the team.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7ec7dea5a736f79f48daddf45ec6f5d1f34e6d6c.jpg
Hope on an PvP in AdventureQuest 3D!
Dage has been addicted to dueling with players in town and the inn. He REALLY likes PvP. So if you see him in game, go for it. A handful of players can claim they downed him so far. He plays fair with perfectly normal stats and gear.

What's in store for the future of PvP? We have been discussing what you will be able to do in the upcoming area... from area matches, battle royale, and team vs team or faction vs faction battles.

Let us know what PvP features you would like to see in the comments section below. (Co-op focused players, we can plot some new team based features in the next post.) PvP on!

For even more adventure, be sure to follow me on:
Facebook: https://www.Facebook.com/ArtixKrieger
Twitter: https://www.Twitter.com/ArtixKrieger
Instagram: https://www.Instagram.com/Artix
YouTube: https://www.Artix.com/YouTube

notes.title: New Battleon! Welcome Home.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9cd51d83883adb73b6d7d7a7bc096c6125631c74.jpg
Welcome Home... to New Battleon!
The Mages time bubble spell allowed months of building to happen in what was a mere instant to us. Behold, our burning hometown has been rebuilt into an entire city! Login and see for yourself...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7a1b29413845fd57fd1c431bb4ee86c67f37c9d4.jpg
The Districts
Town is divided into 4 Districts and one cemetery, in a ring surrounding Guardian Tower. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7a1b29413845fd57fd1c431bb4ee86c67f37c9d4.jpg
Battleon Town Square
The New Battleon Town Square is the main district. In this area you will find the Travel Crystal, Bank, Cysero's Forge, Aria's Petshop, Yulgar's Inn and Bev's Barber Shop. You will also find Prim, the Class Recruiter for quick access to new classes. This area is more-or-less everything that was in old Battleon all in one easy to reach district. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe0c7eb48080c5b47a8643ad47196fe03ecb4c39.jpg

The Social District is a nice spot to grab some dinner...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9841b049c54133eba33336190bc067c720009660.jpg
The Social District
The Social district is the future home of the Guild Hall, Battleon Real Estate where you will go to buy your own house when we release player housing. There's a stage for another band  to play at (you may or may not find several spots around the band that allow you to dance). We want to make this area a lot of fun to just hang out in and when we have parties or celebrations we hope to dress this area up extra special. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3a824a0be9a84856f2df324d6a6862c8248b27d5.jpg
The Trade District
Next is the Trade district. This is the new home of Brigette and B.U.I.L.D. We plan to eventually make this the home player based gathering skills like fishing, mining, cooking and whatever else we can cook up. We want to have these skills play a very large part in how you play and the things you can craft so they needed their own home. If we ever able to make it a reality, this might even be the home of a player-based auction house (but that's a very big project)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0b9e3383184ba3c5b7c490f90d592464a5fa3623.jpg
The Scholar District
Next comes the Scholar district. Warlic has his shop in this area. The Class trainers are there now too. This will also be the future home of the New Battleon Museum which you will fill up with your adventures (and might be able to see replays of historical events like the time Vane burned down Battleon), and the future home of the New Battleon Library.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/de2b8b65e142d8a33376ec2b7d615988f93a88f5.jpg
The Cemetery
Finally, there's the cemetery. This place is dead. 

Seriously though, with the undead being so prominent a part of Lore, you can expect shenanigans. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a880100937ca4feaf8378d7548b7b11060502ef5.jpg
New Tutorial
As soon as you enter town, you will be swept up into the new tutorial elements that new players will experience. They will be taught about classes, the Quest Board (a new piece of functionality that I'll get into in a minute), How to craft things, Death introduces you to the Portal Runes (plot stuff) and gives you a Travel Crystal Shard. 

The Travel Crystal Shard is a item that each player will receive. It cannot be removed from your inventory but does not take up any inventory space and you can use it from anywhere to return to Battleon. Much simpler than finding then using the nav menu in the settings. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/840461a80830e32ef7f68c2e8e6c37f2c1d97fdc.jpg
The Quest Board - Herald Of Hope Set
The Quest Board is the new home for Daily Boss Dungeons, Random Adventures and two new sections Local Jobs and Level Quests.

Local Jobs will help guide you through adventurers in New Battleon. For example, you will receive a quest to help Bev in the Barber Shop and that quest will remain active in New Battleon until you complete Bev's entire quest chain. Once it's done, you can turn it in and it directs you to the Bank, and so on. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b256d297df4eeba93f75b10b77902abc218e4214.jpg

Level quests are new quests to give players something to do. They are divided into levels 1-10, 11-15, 16-20 and 21-25. Whatever level you are, the proper level option will be the last one available to you until you level unto your new bracket. These quests all reward you with LEVEL TOKENS that you can use to slowly craft the HERALD OF HOPE set at Cysero's Forge. BTW, Battle Gem and Daily Boss crafting are both now on Cysero too. 

Once you craft all the cosmetic versions of the Herald of Hope set you can use your Level Tokens and the cosmetic version of this set to craft a LEVEL 27 full set of the Herald of Hope!
LEVEL 27?!
Yeah, we raised the level cap to 27 in this release! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2f1e95b7bdbbd513b77a20d66f2cdc64d03ff4c.jpg
This Is Just The Beginning! 
There tons of little areas to explore in the new town and we want to fill each one with something cool to do eventually but for the time being we have added a few exploration badges and tiles for you to search for.  See if you can find them all!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9cd51d83883adb73b6d7d7a7bc096c6125631c74.jpg

notes.title: War at 74%! New cutscenes unlocked... not everyone survives
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1f3339337d0e3d94cbba9e13a36cd0f4f23977d5.jpg

The 3rd cutscene has been unlocked...

Vane, the VoidKing, has personally arrived in town to address you directly. The 3rd cutscene of the war has been unlocked... and not everyone survived. Watch them by talking to Brigitte the Builder.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ca7f4ee669dfdd78ba291174c1d9c6b2a345cf15.jpg

World Event

What you are experiencing in AdventureQuest 3D this week is a one-time only world event. It will permanently change our world.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1b119ba068537ffdfd68c110a06106e8cdd9d6fa.jpg
Brigitte the Builder

Brigitte is the expert foreman of B.U.I.L.D. ( Battleon Under Imminient Loss and Destuction. ) She is overseeing the efforts of magi, craftsmens, and the transmutations to rebuild town. Even while it is still under attack. We did say she was an expert. Talk to her in town to watch the cutscenes that have unlocked.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c7d7910e535d27b1e8065c56fa2fdc1103454378.jpg

Cutscenes Unlocked

In the three cutscenes that were unlocked, we got our first glimpse of Vane's Fortress. We also learned the name of the Void Priestess. My favorite cut-scene is the one were you rally the forces. But perhaps the most memorable will be the newest one that just unlocked. Finally, we stood toe to toe with Vane one more time... not everyone survives the encounter. And no, there is no coming back from what Vane does. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3eec5b6d3913723f740eeddee65d3c0b6946aa68.jpg

Almost there!

The war to rebuild Battleon is now at 74%.... remember your days here before this war fondly.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/93065e2d7418274ee036995cc1fb7257bd02d885.jpg

...because you and your fellow heroes actions here today will rebuild Battleon as a great City. And what you do next will wipe that grim off of Vane's lip-less mouth. He's going to pay for what he did here.

notes.title: May the 4th be with yooOOMG they burned down our town!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/eee749eb938b36750ed0676d567434f6be094740.jpg
We're just about to celebrate "May the 4th be with you"... but our home town of Battleon is now a smoldering pile of ash!
It actually happened. Vane's army burned every building in your town to the ground. In fact, Vane is on his way now to address you personally. We expect it to happen when the war meter hits 66%. Yes, there's a war meter. It fills up when you collect rocks and wood. Because, Vane can take our home from us... but he cannot take our spirits. We're going to rebuild.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/6d757d177059601b6156d7c55aace16e0d514209.jpg
Melodia & Campbell rally heroes to rebuild Battleon!
We fought to the last stone... which, apparently Gaz wants to sell. Greedly little @#$. But we NEVER GIVE UP! We're going to rebuild it. Bigger. Better. A new town? NO. This time, we're building a CITY. Help gather the resources. ALL monsters across the world now drop stone and wood. Collect and bring it to Brigitte the builder. You can find her and her crafting shop in the ashes that were once our town. You can also craft a "Last Brick" of Battleon from her for free. Because... 10g says Gaz's brick came from Falconreach.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/385aa5b01784230e94c712ef24de50cd7c085023.jpg
Be part of this Special World Event!

Login and be a part of this once-in-a-lifetime special event. New cutscenes will unlock as the war reaches 33%, 66%, and 100% on the builder. There are also new B.U.I.L.D. armors to craft. From the ashes of our former town, together, we will build our biggest, strongest, best version of Battleon ever. Heroes are defined in their most challenging moments. This moment, is ours... together, will make Vane regret ever stepping his armored foot into our home.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fbab4c01e8dce1dda433a089e821206ab8c5837b.jpg

P.S. Join this week's #ScreenShotSaturday to document this event, and also for a chance to score some treasure chests. I think there's 30 up for grabs this week. Hey, it's only two or three times per game that the town gets wrecked this bad :D


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0ca06c90239ced8a5108bcc90120525984942846.jpg
"The Target Lock One" or "The Camera One"... whichever you like better.
In the newest version of AdventureQuest 3D, the main bad guy burns your town to a crisp while the team makes the experience of observing the carnage 26.9% more better-er. Improvements include:


TARGET LOCK!!!!
Camera & Targeting improvements. (Things will not pop at you when you move to close to them any more
Fixed Pirate showing wrong Ultimate Skill in Class Interface.
Minor quest flow fixes.
Party Member target are no longer dropped based on distance.
Drop target logic is now based on camera view instead of character rotation
Added multi-step tutorial framework (What even is this!? Sounds fancy)
If the Area of Effect target is off, the character will face the camera view instead


These changes should make the game more fun to play on both Mobile and Computers.

Read all the newest official posts at www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Updated Game Plan!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d0fdf4d6bf29b265a9710f3e6bf27dd16e3682cd.jpg

AdventureQuest 3D's Updated Game Plan!

We are officially in a 2-month mega sprint! I updated AdventureQuest 3D's official Game Plan plan so you can see exactly what we are working on.

The "BIG 3" from this list will be the world story (which revolves around the new Battleon... big enough that we should call it a citadel. ), Game improvements (combat, inventory, questing), and smoothing out the new player experience. On the Game Plan webpage, you will see a larger list of upcoming areas in our world. I do not think seeing the list will be a spoiler. Many long time players very likely expected to see a lot of these places. There are certainly a few places that WERE NOT added to that list... for good reason. XD

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4152acae43376cda8373279d037f1e42b7acaa39.jpg

"Fight to the Undeath"
Did you ever want to summon undead and fight them? We have been experimenting with a way to do just that as a part of the Tower of Necromancy. As you unlock pages of the tower's evil spell book, you will be able to summon increasingly more powerful minions. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/12b2e9b89227347333a50f5be6a9fa1057ea08a4.jpg

One of the best April Fools events yet!
...and it tested a new feature.
For two weeks we had been talking about how Cysero was trying to craft things the strange and shape-shifting substance called "mutatium". Resulting into last Monday's April Fool's gag where the mutatium got into the air. Players, pets, monster, and characters all got randomly shaped and sized... even in cutscenes. It was hilarious... See for yourself in the screenshot gallery. Many players wisely figured out that this was also a test to see how feasible it would be to eventually allow character size & shape customization.

Last weekend for April Fools items
Hop on this weekend and get your April Fools items from the shop. The shop will disappear on Monday for another year. 

Thank you
On behalf of the entire team, thank you for making AdventureQuest 3D possible. The next 2 months of development are going push our team far past our existing limits. Keep an eye on the game plan. I will keep it updated weekly for you as we do whatever it takes to make the game bigger and more fun for you. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.content:

The Isle of the Dead isn't finished with you yet, hero.

A Beacon In The Darkness

Passing ships have become a problem for the Isle of the Dead. The Mistress of the Tower of Necromancy has commanded apprentice necromancer, Sacrum Deadsea, to come up with a solution for the problem. Help him build his beacon and he has a nice new item to give you as a reward!

Three brand new exploration badges have been added to the Isle of the Dead. Search high and low until you discover all three and claim the titles for yourself! 

"Or... you know... just use people's friend codes and teleport to them like some kind of goon who is allergic to fun." - Cysero

A selection of April Fools seasonal rares will be returning on Monday
Monday is April 1st. So I am writing to tell you, with 100% certainty, that we will not have any jokes or pranks. You're just too smart for it. You caught us two years ago when we said toddlers got into our server room replacing all of our in-game art with crayon. Or that time we turned every character in the game into a stick figure to "save on bandwidth costs". We get it. Your on to us. So nope... not gonna do anything Monday.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/54d0a2d4bb2ce050e9a2167b89870ff5dfa87ebd.jpg

Thank you and coming next week!
Behind the scenes, this was a huge week for AdventureQuest 3D. We are currently in early access, but have been laying out the new game plan which will take us to 100% live. Be sure to check out the official www.AQ3D.com and read the daily design notes we have been writing you. On the last design notes, Cysero sorta leaked that we had a big opportunity for AdventureQuest 3D pop up... we are going for it. Cross your fingers for it. Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: The Isle of Dead.... unlock the Tower of Necromancy.
notes.content:

The Isle of Dead.... unlock the Tower of Necromancy.
The ferryman of DoomWood will now take you to... the Isle of the Dead. A place brimming with sinister secrets that only you can uncover. Should you brave the undead there, and be judged worthy, perhaps you will gain entrance to the Tower of Necromancy. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/589ddab062e10c2ba1c4048a64c6334b82f2e0f6.jpg
Viscerra Vex - Master of the Spirit Crystals
A new cast of strange characters awaits you on the Isle of the Dead. Viscerra Vex is every Paladin's nightmare. Her gift is bottling the spirit energy of the fallen into batteries... an elegant craft of evil.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e898f2ce040f18c257c55f58a22bf75928cca232.jpg
Mazrak the Mad - Yup, he's crazy. Or... is he?
Not everyone on this island has secrets to share, however. In fact, some of them are just flat-out crazy, like Mazrak the Mad. Or... is he? I dunno, hanging out on a nearly-deserted island of the undead can do that to you.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8a9ff26a9eb45a5379c9e1dfca06532442d877d5.jpg
Lady of the Crimson Lake
Once upon a time, a hero sat by by the scarlet waters of the Crimson Lake. Gazing into the distance, there was a skeletal hand... reaching out as if waiting to be handed something.  Something you only thought could happen to Kings in legends.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4d8489ceeb63d440fe760317f69bdfef25959aef.jpg
The Undead Legion awaits... 
In other un-deadly news, there is still time to get this year's  Dage Collection 2019 . This sinister set includes owerful weapons of chaos and destruction... should you choose to wield them. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/313b1df1bf93cf98a1af51286cb193c033b3e1f6.jpg
Become a Necromancer
If creating a powerful force of undead minions sounds exciting to you, talk to Stygis in DoomWood. Begin the journey to becoming a Necromancer. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/363ebae3cfc0bf6d19f3fb0ad5b65aa4ec247de3.jpg
"Mutatium could lead to a potential scientific discovery," says mad weaponsmith Cysero.
Cysero bought a mysterious material from the shady black market sales-sneevil, Gaz. Cysero is has been experimenting on how to forge it into something useful. But it keeps changing shape! (We're not actually sure where this is going... but you might want to keep up to date with Cysero's news posts.)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fd501fc49f2683b37a45a4cd13cd43edc8ae030a.jpg

We hope you enjoy this new AdventureQuest 3D story release. While I promise you there will certainly be brighter releases in the future... this one begins a dark journey which will take you into realms never meant for the good, nor living.

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Necromancer Class! Now available for all players to unlock.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/313b1df1bf93cf98a1af51286cb193c033b3e1f6.jpg
Necromancer class available for all players to earn!
Visit Stygis and take your first step to becoming a Master of the Undead! Learn how to make your own friends. It's sorta like a healer class for really, really, really late heroes. Sorta.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4125340e8e50f03c6ce7213fbe0ee69179efe309.png
Necromancer Class
Necromancers are magic users who have mastered control over the forces of life and death. They use their dark powers drain the souls of the living and summon undead servants which obey their every command. Using souls which you harvest upon slaying foes, you can cast the following spells.
Default Cast - A ranged attack that pulls out your foes life force feeding your soul count.Soul Siphon - Rip Souls from the target, dealing damage. Deals increased damage and steals Health from enemies recently attacked by summoned minions.Dark Decay - Inflict an enemy with necrotic Decay, dissolving the target's Armor and dealing damage over time. Decay transfers Souls to the Necromancer.Summon Undead - Expend Souls and summon an undead minion to attack your target. Summoned minions do not survive long.(ULTIMATE) Grand Summon - Tap into the true forces of necromancy, summoning a powerful creature with the ability to Taunt groups of enemies.(CROSS-SKILL) Bone Prison - Summon a cage of bone to hold your enemy.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/dc42971a018526f9a85606bb619d1c4743483cac.jpg

Hello... I'm Mr. DEAD

A horse is a horse, of corpse, of corpse...
And no one can talk to an undead horse of corpse...
Unless its the corpse, of a famous horse....
Is the famous MR. DEAD.

*ends singing*

It pains me that I have to post this Mr. Ed theme song lyrics to explain the above to those who think I just lost my mind. (Also, spoiler: I lost my mind at least two posts ago... and the decent into the mental abyss is going to be beautiful That is why you feel the irresistible urge to keep reading these.

Back to your regularly scheduled DoomWood Post
Per your request, we created a unique silhouette for the Tower of Necromancy. It is located in the middle of the Crimson lake. Many of our older maps including DoomWood were super tiny compared to the new maps we have been building. We have envisioned a much larger over arching storyline for AdventureQuest 3D's forest of the dead. The #1 goal of this revamp is to make this the lower level "starting point" in DoomWood that will be easily expanded past the Tower of Necromancy, past the Castle of Bone, through the Necropolis and beyond. notes.title: Surprise! You can PvP on the public test server right now.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/51db2fc321909d13894549d91e766a29711b5be4.jpg

Player vs Player (PvP) now available for all players to test
Well, that escalated quickly. The very first version of PvP is in testing now, and if you can play AdventureQuest 3D on STEAM, you can give it a try. Needless to say it is pretty primitive... but oh man is it a lot of fun. We need help testing, reporting bugs, and thinking up clever things to do.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f8bad8cb6574cffe0b27851545bb5727caa2f27d.jpg

PvP is... really fun!
Gotta say, had some reservations about this but OMG it is a blast. Broke my 10 year streak of not PvPing with any players.  Did not regret. Other than Owl will probably post a video of it on his YouTube channel, LOL! At least you know I was preoccupied taking screenshots and messing with stuff XD

When you travel to PvP from your travel menu, you will appear in a secret part of the Guardian Tower. You will already have been automatically assigned to a team. The enemy team is waiting for you... but that is OK, you start in a "safe area" where you cannot be hurt. Once you cross the threshold into the main room, it is anything goes. Potions work, Paladin heals work, Necromancer works. The Ninja's sprint ability is no longer a laughing stock once you use warrior, Paladin, or any other melee class. A well composed team makes all the difference. Two mages and a warrior are a wrecking ball.  It surprised me how fun it was... and there are not even any objectives yet. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/54ad79d8dada4c94cade83ba8f9b719790c98d11.jpg

When will PvP be released on the LIVE game server?
We made a smart call putting PvP on our testing server first. A lot of stuff is going to need rapidly fixed, changed, balanced, and de-bugged. Unfortunately, it is only possible to experience this on STEAM right now. I really wish there was an easier way to do this on mobile. But it will not be long before everyone can try out PvP on the live servers from your phone, tablet, and PC/Mac/Linux etc. Again, we have a date in mind... but I do not want to say it and jinx myself (again). Currently on the public test server, anyone can try it out (even through it says it is Guardian Only). But, as promised, PvP will initially available to Guardians only.
How to access AdventureQuest 3D's Public Test Game & Server

Switching between the live and public test versions of AdventureQuest 3D is pretty easy. In your STEAM game library, right click on AdventureQuest 3D. If AdventureQuest 3D is not already in your FAVORITES list >_> this is clearly a human error and you need to "Add to favorites." XD OK, that is not mandatory... but it will certainly make it easier to get to the game later. To switch your game version, right click on AdventureQuest 3D and click on "Properties". Then choose the "BETAS" tab. Then choose "publictest - PTR". It installs super quick, the game client is surprisingly small. When you log in, it will let you know you are on the PTR version and tell you how to switch it back if you cannot find this post for some reason :D

To switch back to the normal version  simply right click AdventureQuest 3D, choose properties, choose the BETAS tab, and then choose "NONE - Opt out of all Beta Programs". This will set you back to the normal version of the game.

I highly recommend clearing your cache after switching between the normal and PTR games. This button wipes out all the map files, temp data, etc. You will automatically download the newest map files the first time you go to them.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a453f98466db2b4257f6136c4a186878b7701011.jpg

How to get to the PvP map in game
When you are inside the game, just open your menu and choose travel. PvP is the top option. Open your Menu and choose Travel. It will take you to our little PvP testing room deep within a dungeon.

See you on the Battlefield! - Artix

Ninja Class just released in AdventureQuest 3D!
The Ninja class has just been released! Find Thyton (the guy in the golden spartan looking helm who may or may not be a ninja...) in town. He will show you the way... of the ninja.  But beware! The path to becoming a ninja is fraught with peril... and new craftable item and armor sets.

notes.title: LIVE! Rank up your Classes and Unlock Cross-Skills
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e0d4e7533b002295389637e724ac1f010e8e653b.jpg

Rank every class up to 10 & Unlock all the new Cross-Skills!

In today's new version of AdventureQuest 3D you can rank up your classes and unlock special cross-skills.... yup, these are new skills you can equip and use with any class! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e96e06ad7b23291c35fd8dbf72eca906797a8d1f.png

Necromancers unlock "Bone Prison" at rank 10 which summons a cage of bone to hold your enemy in place. This would be useful to equip to any class. Necromancer will be available for all players to earn when the Tower of Necromancy goes live in DoomWood soon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5419004cb4665f7167eda71ec6ecffde66a7f9a4.jpg

Rogues get Affliction at rank 10 which deals double damage and poisons the target. Equip this skill to any class to add some damage over time.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/95ba127fc548734fe4b4ae35964ff2a3d1fe87bb.jpg

Paladins unlock Holy Bolt at rank 10 which is a ranged attack, dealing damage to your foe and healing nearby allies. Equip this skill on any class to add a little extra healing power.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7550cb51dfa3887ca89cbce7bab8df9a2e35c8ec.jpg

Dragonslayers unlock the Rend skill at rank 10. Ever notice how some monsters resist your damage? This skill sneaks past the armor damaging more direct damage. This version is extremely effective against Dragons. Equip it to any class to become more effective at dealing damage.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7550cb51dfa3887ca89cbce7bab8df9a2e35c8ec.jpg

Warriors unlock Seismic Slam at Rank 10 which is an area-of-effect attack hitting everything in melee range. Add this skill to any class to have an AOE (Area of Effect) that is useful for pulling, or even just tagging lots of monsters so you are assured to get their loot.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/82139e73535b83638c62f48708056d3c4079cfea.jpg

Mages unlock the Rune Siphon at Rank 10 which places a magical rune on your foe dealing damage over time. It is similar to the Rogue's, but try this one out to see how it can be extra effective with your other classes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0a4ecc87fa1c3b0143ccb18370a11ff4ef4e9aa1.jpg

The Ninja unlocks the Spint skill at rank 10, giving you a sudden burst of speed. Now any class can become an Olympic pro-athlete short distance runner :D "Run forest, run!"

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f9c153e522c7e6200096d3eca2ccb98e8c66be62.jpg

Feeling lucky? Pirate class unlocks the Lucky Shot skill at rank 10. This is a guaranteed critical hit which, when used cleverly with some other classes abilities is likely to be a magnificent balancing nightmare :D Add this skill to any class to add a wicked K.O.

Hope you love Class Ranks! We're fixing bugs and want your feedback

The team worked really hard on this release and we hope you are enjoying it. We are already neck-deep in fixing a number of bugs including the one where you see "other people's rank ups". Like all big game-play changing releases, we listen. So let us know both the things you like and the things you think need changed in the comments section of class ranks posts on the official website. 
https://aq3d.com/news/rankupandunlockcrossskills/

Also, we are working double hard to get all of the early access classes released so you and all players can earn them. The Necromancer is coming with the Tower of Necromancy, but we might need to put all classes on the trainers with daily quests to speed up the process. Good luck ranking up all your classes!

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team 
www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Xur's Curse! New treasure chest items including Chaos's Grasp
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9de55a0fe9a749e34435791c8f676d20dd4ccfc5.png

Every day you log in and join us in AdventureQuest 3D, you get a free treasure chest to open! Now there are even more items for you to discover including the new ones pictured above. Xur's Curse is one of our favorite new items you can score. There are two versions: one you can wield and a pet that floats and follows you. Both feature a creepy animated eyeball. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/80af4cc08d167e58a0f97cc04603e4d6e9e53b7f.jpg

XUR'S CURSE & CHAOS'S GRASP
Wielded by a treacherous and deceptive rogue, legend says that Xur's Bane was the dagger which did Xur in. She was the only one who could get close enough to kill Xur. Others tried, oh, so many tried. But Xur's sword was all seeing, for at the center of its hilt is an inhuman, glaring eye. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/269fff6c262d1366f34d048c67006ac69f4e2017.jpg

If that horrifying blade had a name, it has been lost to history. Now the sword is simply known as Xur's Curse.  It foresaw every attack, giving Xur an unstoppable advantage. Until, of course, the rogue appeared. Beguiled by her beauty and skill, Xur took her on as an apprentice. She got close to Xur... too close. 

As Xur laid in bed, dying from her dagger wound, he looked into his apprentice's eyes and said, "Thank you... for freeing me from the sword..."

She must have lived long enough to tell that tale but after that, no one knew what happened to the rogue or the two weapons.

Until today.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3e654c9af758c89d80004ae3256b1fd19bdaec2c.jpg

New Mask in Darkon's Birthday Shop

notes.title: Darkon's Garage Sale of Debris
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fdc1d56524c92ef4708bec0745a93b7fda9e0491.jpg

Darkon's Garage Sale of Debris
Introducing Darkon-- former hero turned artifact collector. It has become a yearly tradition to sell off the dregs of his immense collection to make room for more valuable pieces. Good new for you. Until you look at the price tag at least. What the heck is Darkon thinking? ...and something feels "unusual" about these items he is peddling.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c63f2f15d89e46e909b9a6280b0ef0e6d2aa62d8.jpg

Class Quests! Warrior, Mage, and Rogue
Do you wish you could look more warrior-y, or mage-y, or rogue-y? Well now you can! Visit the class trainer shop and take on some quests to earn new class specific armor. Disclaimer: Side effects may include: big mage hat,  masked rogue hood, winged warrior helm, and a rash in the armpits and unspeakable places. Check with your healer if trainer class quests are right for you. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2cd63eefc6f2900865a1b4501b7439e2e14ff1ad.jpg

Dage flexes his artistic range
Dage is famous for his dark and evil items... but it turns out he's not too shabby at making elegant & deadly things too. You will be able to craft these in next week's release-- which will add new random adventures to the travel crystal. Which is also, let's face it, is a filler quest week while the team participates in next week's game jam. #transparency

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b4abe83b8bf2a16250e320f3c63120bed436356.jpg

"A Hero's Home is their Castle." 
Check out the post I made for you that is filled to Llusions concept art of the upcoming Kingdom of Battleon. This is an important part of the bigger world of Lore we will be building together this year. 
https://aq3d.com/news/kingdomofbattleon2019/ 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/132e44a37c08855fe4624eb9dacdcfd047062583.jpg

Class ranks and Cross skills
You can collect and switch between classes in AdventureQuest 3D. In testing now, is the system that will allow you to rank your class up. When you hit rank 10, you will unlock a "Cross Skill". This is a special skill that you can equip to any class. Read more about it at...
https://aq3d.com/news/classranksandcrossskills/ 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/dd7a436b9e83222e7b839f7a40f9aa172bf218ff.jpg

Thank you and on to 2019!
Hope your year is off to an amazing start. I posted a youtube video of the fireworks thingy we did on New Year's eve. If you missed it, or liked it, then good news-- I want to do a lot more events like this. On this topic, ff you are doing the New Year's resolution, be sure to check out the lengthy "ghoul setting" guide I posted for you. The undead slaying Paladin themed video game motivational success planning post you never knew you needed. See you in game!

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. MJ from MassivelyOverpowered is visiting the lab this weekend. 
P.S.S. Ninja Warrior competitor Reko Rivera asked for our help building his submission video this year with segments of AdventureQuest 3D footage.

notes.title: Kingdom of BattleOn (Concept Art)
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b4abe83b8bf2a16250e320f3c63120bed436356.jpg

"A Hero's Home is their Castle..."
This year, we will be building a much bigger world of Lore together in AdventureQuest 3D.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a56cc63938fcb7f76da281267f1c3a6f1970190f.jpg

In our previous games, the Town of Battleon has been a small town near a cross roads. How about an upgrade?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/95d4d202b93ebc172805c79d89382b543e27defc.jpg

There are two notable things about our home town. First, Heroes seeking adventure, fame, and fortune are drawn to it... mostly because it is located smack dab in middle of our worlds most monster turbulent areas. Second, it is home to the Guardians... the sworn defenders of our world. The Guardian Tower has always been the central focal point of our town.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0864ec5dc192d3dc5745c0e7027296750afba554.jpg

Llusion created concept drawings of our town as a Kingdom. A massive upgrade bringing stone roads, new shops, and even protective bridges leading outside of town.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f7c67a4a69e3f52cd5efd81396bb19afe226df44.jpg

The town square is re-imagined around the travel crystal (we actually have a different one not pictured here for spoiler reasons). The town would be split into several sections allowing it to be more dense with activity... npcs walking the streeths, outside seating like in Lolosia, and easier to access shops. And a lot.. more shops.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/55d61eac0631c8d94c40e9cbfccbbc5bc89ce7c6.jpg

2019 is going to be a very interesting year. Battleon is the central hub of a large number of new areas (and revamped existing areas) coming in AdventureQuest 3D. Along with this we are designing our world map and re-doing how familiar areas are connected.

Here is an earlier concept without the town walls... which is decidedly less kingdom-like. In posting these screen shots it may appear that we have everything completely figured out. But other than creating assets we have not laid any bricks yet so if you have great ideas for what you really want in town (you know, when you come home from your adventures), this is a great place to let us know.
We would LOVE to hear your thoughts & ideas on these thingsShould the Kingdom of Battleon to have have a Castle and King? (Separate from Guardian Tower)Should you be able to enter every building you can walk to?What shops are the MOST vital -- the ones that should be in town square (Bank, Forge, Petshop, etc?)

notes.title: Journey to Frostvale!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/883a02f45a6c9860088ef2ec52117c6f7f8549f5.jpg

Happy Frostval! The time has once again arrived for heroes and frost moglins alike to crowd close around the hearth, sing merry Frostval tunes, and mercilessly slaughter snow monsters. 

Travel to Frostvale and explore the new town. While you're there, throw some snowballs at other heroes, quest through the holiday releases, and be sure to get that free ugly sweater armor for free... because it's free. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e4721ca8a7ac2d5381a3242791cd0bd086abd4be.jpg

Hurl a Snowball at someone
You will find snowballs on the ground in Frostvale. Yup, you can throw them! Monsters also have a chance of dropping Sniper Snowballs. These have a 100% chance irritating the player you want to annoy the most. Just equip them to your skill bar and let 'er rip.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b7b6489cd14fb1e191ba38f759a6ae2fa71b19aa.jpg

Craft new Frozen Items
"Icy what you did there..." There are about 25 Glacial items you can craft in Frostvale. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fba3d3c42fc1cba0c4e047f224cf7c9327bc6291.jpg

Frost Labyrinth Returns
Play through the events of Frostval past. The Yettun is an abominable snow monster which attacked the Frost Moglins and took control of their lands. Only the little Frost Moglin, Blizzy, was brave enough to stand up to him... but Blizzy is going to need your help.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f733a0d71a3f526a9fa233498e682a2c33264110.jpg

Challenge Fight! You vs Frostlorn Raiders
Battle the three leaders of the army attacking our home town. Faustbite, Phrozen and Sleet hail from that massive castle you will see in the distance, looming over Frostvale. But this week, you can gather friends to take all three of them on and craft awesome gear. Next week... we will enter their castle!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/df54ec8d06a789829e539b2a5f5293d1d5f58186.jpg

Ugly Bush Sweater released to honor players who slew 9.5 Million HP holiday shrub
Uh. Yes. This actually happened. Players battled a single festively decorated holiday bush for 5+ hours in Yulgars Inn. It had over 9,500,000 HP. AdventureQuest 3D may have some of the craziest gamers in the world. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ebaab21d0cc0f4d8c5f711a50fde8ba829063dab.png

So, to honor them, we have released an Ugly Bush Sweater Armor for all players. You can get it from Blizzy in Frostvale, but beware, rumors are spreading that the bushes are quietly plotting (potting?) their revenge. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2dddd9e37b6746bae184dccf5e444038a5f43ff1.jpg

The 2019 Artix Entertainment Calendars are shipping!
We are signing them and shipping them from the lab now. Includes code to unlock in-game items. You can still get your calendar at www.HeroMart.com.  If you got your calendar along with your Moglins at www.Artix.com/Moglins then you will be happy to know we split up your order and are sending your calendars now. 
https://www.HeroMart.com

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1ecd7a176678bd2cbe870b8bcd1ae4f396e058d8.jpg

Get 50% Bonus DragonCrystals
Since you've already seen this promo a few times, instead about talking about it, I will talk about how this may be our most blue-themed news upset ever! So much blue! Seriously, scroll through and just feast your eyes on all of the blue. Also, Cysero is sitting beside me endlessly humming Frostval music. I might have to hurt him soon. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f4fa307bb60c38d9690452eac785447b006288fe.jpg

The Frostlorn Castle is coming next week
Get ready to enter the Frostlorn Castle next week. Be warned, the Frostlorn itself is HUGE. The boss fight will be special much like the Braken and Fire Dragon battles. You can see video clips of both of these fights in the new AdventureQuest 3D which just dropped. Going to add it here to Steam shortly. Meanwhile, if you have been opening your free daily treasure chests, you should have your first rare Warlord chest by now. Hope you got (or are about to get) something awesome. See you in Frostvale!

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. I know this is weird... but "Frostvale" (with an E at the end) is the town. "Frostval" is the Holiday. In case you were wondering why I kept writing it differently.

Storm Defender

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e3b1bd0966b37b686636d327ce6edb1aceff381e.jpg

2018 Pirate Collection (Ends Monday)
2018 Black Friday Collection (Ends Monday)
2018 Mogloween Collection (Ends when 2018 Frostval Collection goes live)

notes.title: You got a Treasure Chest! What's inside?
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5565c96a4b00094551893e24ccf0a077a2eb1f7f.jpg

Login to AdventureQuest 3D and open your treasure chest. 
What's in there? Is it Dragon Crystals? Yes! What about pets, potions, armors, wicked looking weapons? Yes! There's over 130 new items. You can get them all for just logging in.... because we are giving you a new treasure chest to open every single day.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f5177d5c414ef83ba7242abd444f1f7c0c1c5a30.jpg

130+ new items added in this new release
So, those chests contain pets, a towel, weird potions that can transform you into things, awesome new armor sets and more. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3022b389f26bbe9b772dcaa9152a52c41802866e.jpg

Get a Treasure Chest every day when you login
At last! If you are a long time player, then you know this release is actually the "daily login reward" stretch goal that was unlocked by the Kickstarter backers. This reward... is for all players. Login every day to get a free chest containing some free DragonCrystals, potions, surprise items, and more. Every chest has a chance to drop a Legendary quality item.

Also, every 7 days you will get a special chest with even better rewards! Don't worry if you miss a day. We don't reset your progress. It will just continue from where you left off, moving you towards that glorious ultimate reward on day #28, the epic-item-filled Emperor's Chest!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1ecd7a176678bd2cbe870b8bcd1ae4f396e058d8.jpg

Last chance! Get 50% More Dragon Crystals
Get 50% EXTRA Dragon Crystals on any Dragon Crystal purchase from now until January 2nd! With a Frostval Collection coming up, it's the perfect time to make sure you're ready for the holidays.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33a79ded62df507f7222fa9e39afec1315e083cd.jpg

Raid on Frostlorn Ice Castle (Coming soon!)
Last year, under the cover of a magical snow storm, the Frostlorn Raiders attacked our town. This year we will be taking the fight to them! Soon we shall journey to the Frozen Northlands where the Frostlorn Ice Castle stands like an icy blade erupting from the snow drifts that cover the land. The image above is Dage's concept art for boss monster. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9c4ba6956ca5759068ce31490c26c945616fdb59.jpg
Watch Vesper's weekly Artix video game update video

Thank you!
When I logged into the game today, I was blown away by the sheer variety of armors, pets, and creative looking characters. Felt good. Felt like the game suddenly came alive. Combine this with amazing releases like the huge Vampire Castle, the Pirate town of Lolosia....  Well, it feels great being a part of this as the game grows and hits its stride. In the background we are hard at work on new (and many existing) areas, adventures, and improvements to nearly every area of the game. I am grateful to you and everyone supporting AdventureQuest 3D's ongoing development. The upgrades or purchases you made this holiday season are making it possible for us to continue making the game better each week. 

Login and get your daily AdventureQuest 3D treasure chest. See you in game. 

Battle on!
Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team

Artix &the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Talk Like a Pirate Day 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/312d1eadd995ca4358b8121c9cae68787ca58834.jpg

Happy Talk Like a Pirate Day

Login and join us in the Pirate Town of Lolosia. There's a whole lotta new faces to meet... and an epic adventure of pirating and plundering across the high seas


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/41ec9260c0d788168414229a902a0df24cb4cb97.jpg

Pirate Class

All players can now start earning the Pirate Class through daily quests! Once you have unlocked the class, you can then use those Pirate Tokens to unlock Pirate Armor and our first free travel form.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8b2aeef520f4a4db475cff2a0c3649a32987cbd9.jpg

New Adventure & Monsters

Battle all new monsters like the Sea Ogre, Megadon (next week), Hammerhead Zard, Deeplings, the horrifying Flyshimi Fish, Clawgmurai, and the Bilge Rats... which are technicaly "Pi-RATS" if you think about it. The main event at the end of this first part of the saga is an epic BOSS battle at sea. If you enjoyed the Fire Dragon (Akriloth) battle from Ashfall, you are going to LOVE this.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a3f00df7e23bc1860e55ab62da7bc6483aeec365.jpg

Behold Untold Told Secrets

Level cap raised!
There are new travel badges to be found.
Guardians can get 5 extra Pirate Tokens per day to earn the class a little faster.
And the Moglin Scurvy in town... will tell you a different story each time you buy him a drink.


 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d489706fc9a3687ace24a596098e262807230249.jpg

Pirate Collection 2018

Get your favorite items individually, or get the entire 2018 Pirate Collection! This year we have Land Shark and Cursed Pirate travel forms... a wicked array of Pirate gear including peg legs, stylish armor, hand cannons, and more! The collection includes a badge and the title "Sea Marauder"


 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ae8605af4460265f75421d4ac967ae4c6fa07033.jpg
Story, Shops, & things to "Sea"

There are a lot of new faces in town... many of them have shops or the skill to craft items using the things you find on your adventures.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f88ae1cea067b409a811248f6c6157889f62254d.jpg

Challenge Battles Coming Next!

Play the Pirate Saga and dive into the story this week... and then, in our next AdventureQuest 3D release, get your friends together for some challenging boss fights! Also in this new release is support for monster telegraphs (projections), pets, and more.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/cd5d7647b672f755708cea5ccda8aab7b9d6a445.jpg

Ahoy! It be time to plunder, pillage, and pirate our way across the seas!

Captain Rhubarb is perhaps the most famous Pirate of our world. I mean, there's no statue of him punching a shark in the face like Peckard, but he's known far and wide. His ship is the Red Betty. You're about to make some incredible memories aboard it. "BATTLE ARRRRRRR!"

notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c32fd1e198505ffdf8839d121f84a7867899a35e.jpg

LIKE A BOSS... MONSTERS!
In this week's release you can take on our first Daily Boss Fight, walk through some grass, quest for an awesome new scythe, wand, and sword, and check out our new and improved art for Warrior, Rogue, & Mage.
https://aq3d.com/news/dailybossfights/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b0ee17071c1af9485a9f6936e04e5f0412d241aa.jpg

Carnivera, the Venus HeroTrap
Rumor has it that something terrible is lurking in Bladderwort Glade. An enormous mutation of a seed spitter... and its seeds can turn even the most hardened hero into a mindless plant-zombie.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/18529c8b7f9cccecee1fe6cd5edb7a557480ac43.jpg

Daily Boss Fights.... OK, that "S" might be a bit pre-mature.
Talk to Twilly in town to check out the Boss Fight of the day! He has a daily quest where you can earn a Boss Fight Trophy. Needless to say the goal is to have a different, random, boss battle each day-- but right now we just have this one. So, give it a try and we will add more bosses very soon!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/56f36c60b6dae0305f972dfe77e94e71963f2fcb.jpg

The Balrog Blade
Artist Darkon re-imagined & crafted the AQWorld's "Balrog Blade" into 3D. All players can earn this by collecting Daily Boss Trophies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/344ae6ef359447657b12bfe3d7c17ec698a45df4.jpg

Bladderwort Glade is officially the first place to support grass in AdventureQuest 3D for PC & Mac players. (Not to be confused with that grass we released in the intro last week that turned all of our game graphics on iPhones pink.) We made two changes to the grass shader... first, it now blends into the ground. Second it has a nice gradient and some subtle randomization. When you walk over the grass, it should react by being pushed by your feet. Feels pretty good!

We will be re-adding grass to the Town of Battleon and the Intro next week.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/75a46c0acf3536fe9ab9f1ad9bacab11491a1627.jpg

It is official... the NEW INTRO IS A WIN!

Thank you for all of the love and cheers for AdventureQuest 3D's new intro. If you have not played it yet, simply login... it will be the first thing that happens when you hit play. Our new big baddie, Vane the Voidking, certainly made an impression... so much that another video game designer called me up to tell me how jealous he was of the games new villain. After the intro went live, our numbers jumped across the board. Our day 1 retention alone increased over 25%! I am really proud of the team's hard work and creativity on this. We are already working on what is coming next...


Town of BattleOn's Shops & World Story
Heartwood & Livingstone Cavern revamp (Berseker?)
DoomWood Revamp (Paladin vs Necromancer)
Lolosia (Pirate) - September (Ninjas will make an appearance but the class will come when we do our Ninja Training Village)
Darkovia Parts III, IV, & V - October-ish?
Live Events
Daily Boss Battles
PvP


Boss Battle on!
Good luck against Carnivera the Venus Herotrap. Let us know what you think of the first Daily Boss Battle... and any fun ideas to take them to the next level as we add more!
https://aq3d.com/news/dailybossfights/

notes.title: AdventureQuest 3D Version 1.10.0 "Grassy Blades of Death!" is LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/710f3e5404adb6f33a686f74e1f44a96c2f9aa19.jpg

Version 1.10.0 "Grassy Blades of Death" is here!
Be sure to grab the newest update of AdventureQuest 3D  from Steam or the App Store. Here is what is new...

This release KICKS GRASS!
...literally. We added support for grass and when you walk over it, it moves. However, none of the maps actually have any grass in it (yet). Grass will be added to the Town of Battleon and outside of Death's lair in the next release. You can toggle grass in the settings.

New Friends Interface
"Let's be better friends!" From your friends list, you can now directly invite someone to your group, or goto them, or summon them, or send them a whisper. (Thank you to MJ from Massively Overpowered for making me realize how important this feature is for playing together.)

Fixed news button disappearing after map change
Apparently, "No news" is NOT good news. This has been fixed.

Bizzaro Character Deformations Fix!
There was a glitch that caused players to bend into unholy positions and break things for other players in the game. Zhoom added checks to prevent this "asset distortion issue". 

Spy on other player's equipped items
What the heck is that player wearing? Now you can know. When you inspect a player you can now see their equipped items-- both actually equipped and cosmetically equipped.

Dual Wield Hand Cannons
The game now supports all the features required to release Pirate and Alpha Pirate. This is, of course, our first dual wielding hand cannon class. This is a new equip slot that all players will have. But will only be usable by classes that use hand cannons.

Mobile Features - Joystick and Auto Run Toggles
By popular demand we have added the option to lock the joystick in place and enable disable auto run. You can auto run on mobile by double tapping the joy stick.

Combat Improvements and Balance Updates
"Don't you hate it when devs write something like this in the patch notes and then do not give any details?" So here are the details....
The game will now only show other players' status effect icons on your target.  Spells that only do damage / DoTs will not have their icon shown.  This is to clear up some icon clutter on the target.Area of Effect abilities now deal 10% less damage or healing to their 2nd target, 20% less to their 3rd target, down to a minimum of 50% damage to their 6th or more targets.To compensate, AoE abilities have had their base power increased. The result should be that these spells do nearly the same or more damage to 3 or fewer targets, but less to a larger number of targets. Targets are damaged in order of highest aggro. Targets are healed in order of lowest percent health left. Class UpdatesWarrior Whirlwind power: 90 -> 100 DragonslayerFinal Descent power: 275 -> 310 Paladin Holy Shield damage reduction 35% -> 25% Divine Judgement power: 175 -> 200Guardian Guardian's Hope base power: 40 -> 55 Necromancer Soul Transfer: Souls on kill 10 -> 15 Soul Siphon power: 70 -> 60 + Enhanced power: 90 -> 80 Grand Summon taunt duration: 5s -> 3.5s

UI Updates
By popular request the action bar is now bigger. But the bad news is there is less space for your chat window. But the good news is the chat window pops up above the bar to give you more space if it does not fit!

Android Users!
AdventureQuest 3D now requires you to be using at least Android 4.4 (Kit Kat). A very small number of players who are not using Android 4.4 or higher need to update your OS in order to play the new version of the game.  

Support for new intro (ALMOST!?)
The new intro "DEATH'S LAIR" requires a few new features. Most are in this build, but we need to roll out at least one more early next week in order to release the new intro and begin AdventureQuest 3D's Main Storyline. So, as a little teaser to get you in the spirit, we updated the game's title screen with a special sneaky peak for you. Battle on!

Also happening this weekend!
Check out Artix Weekly Video Game Review #12 featuring special birthday-girl guest, Mia J. Park. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/783ca0e971f6c55bfd5bc9ffe11a33016e5c2621.jpg
