notes.title: Friday the 13th! Cryo-Shrade & Twilly vs Zorbak War
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/98ab038c7fa42604a0c6780863eb432ee4b766fe.png

A real CHILLER!

Login and battle for your favorite cabin in this weekend's Friday the 13th War! The winning team will have their back flag released for all players. Beware... someone accidentally opened a cryogenic chamber releasing... *message suddenly cut off*

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/37778d0ec515b2441e2721638157e712685dc0f8.jpg

Twilly vs Zorbak Cabins

Prepare for war! This Friday the 13th, battle for either the Twilly or Zorbak Cabins. This is the first time we have ever had a war centered around our two mascot characters. May the best (or worst) moglin win! Oh, we lowered the war meter for this one... it is going to be a fast war!

Twilly - the Red Hero Moglin
Often found on the tree stump in town, Twilly is quick with a heal and a warm smile. Many believe this friendly moglin was the first to make contact with humans. Is he just a loyal friend, or does he play a deeper role in our ultimate destiny? He sure does seem little. Some people would be surprised to hear this little fella once defeated Pax, becoming High Warlord of the Death Arena.

Zorbak - the 100% Ebil Blue Moglin
While most moglins are gifted with powers to help you, Zorbak is more likely to use necromancy to re-animate your food. Often found in the company of insidious villains, this little scheming blue moglin always has a secret plan.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eae667cd115c20022e42662eb8d0ff59d74b81d.jpg

Cryo-Shrade

We thought he was gone. But then scientists discovered a mysterious cryogenic chamber... and they made the mistake of opening it. HE'S BACK! Battle the rare spawn Cryo-Shrade to get new armor, hood, mask, hooded mask and cleaver items.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bd1e7d58b4b94e01dd6119fe1d30e883700595d5.png

Lost Hiker Set

"Wear this... and you can get lost too!"

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/21d2ce56f504820c92033f7998437abf692ec98f.jpg

DEATH'S LAIR! Coming next time on AdventureQuest 3D

We hope you enjoy this special mini-war. We received a lot of messages from players asking why we did not do the new adventure for Shrade that was originally planned. Truth is, we wanted to remain focused on the game's main storyline, including the new intro "Death's Lair" which will introduce AdventureQuest 3D's new main villain, Vane. Hope you agree that putting the time into permanent game content, instead of pushing things back another week for a one-off event is the best use of our time. That being said, when the team and I saw your comments on Youtube and Twitter about not getting a new Shrade... we did not want to let you down. So the team stayed late and went into overtime. They created the new Shrade and 2 armor sets that drop for you just in the nick of time. Any haters can say what they want, but these guys love you.  Happy Friday the 13th!

QUESTION: What Cabin will you be fighting for... TWILLY or ZORBAK?
More News

notes.title: The Dragon's Graveyard: Part II
notes.content:

For this release, our goal was for the game to look EXACTLY like it did yesterday. So even though we updated literally every map, armor, item, and file in the entire game-- nothing should look different to you. If it does, let us know on the bug tracker!

notes.title: Necromancer Testing on the PTR!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5d58a7f26afe170c295cd54f20c85bac7df925e7.jpg

Undead Summoning 101
AdventureQuest 3D's Necromancer class is now available for everyone to test on the PTR (Public Test Realm).

Paladins & Undead Slayers please look the other way for a moment.
As a Necromancer, you summon an undead minion to fight for you. Excellent company if you are feeling lonely. But they do not last long. This first type of Necromancer can only summon a single skeletal minion for a short period of time before it collapses into dust. No worries, summoning more is the fun part. Your special summons a giant skeleton which is extra fun. Everyone is invited to help us test and give us feedback. We have been carefully reading the comments so far and are working on increasing its power, and getting a little life leach when you cast your dark magic. This class plays very differently from our previous ones!
Necromancer Release Schedule

- PTR Testing all Players (Happening now!)
- Live Release for Legendary Tier Kickstarter Backers (As promised)
- Live Release for all Players

More Class News
We are anticipating releasing Paladin for all players in the upcoming Doomwood Revamp. We are not sure if Necromancer will be released there, opposing Paladin (which would be fun-- and I really want to add the Tower of Necromancer). Or, if we will release Necromancer in the Dragon's Graveyard. Meanwhile, Alpha Pirate (Similar to Pirate Class) has had great progress. It is our first dual wielding hand cannon class. Zhoom is adding new equip slots to the database (Bow & Guns) to support the new models and animations we have ready. Finally, Ninja has had some setbacks. The original "different skills cause different combos to start" style game-play was ultimately too confusing. Rabblefroth is trying something different. I am still crossing my fingers for shirken and double jump. Battle on!

notes.title: World Tree 2: Dream Plane
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5beaf9a3c5f8e4447f73141fd1c79120d6336245.jpg

The Finale of Slifsgaard's Shaman Area!
The World Tree, the linchpin of multiple worlds, is still in danger! In the first half of the World Tree story, Slifsgaard taught you about what it means to be a shaman in Lore, You traveled to four different elemental crossplanes to get the permission from the elemental Aspects to enter the Dream Plane. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/55e76ee1200a463edfe7325a85324eb5fbb828c2.jpg

Our BIGGEST Boss Fight ever, new masks, weapons, and more!
Now, you must travel to the world of dreams, where the Void Knightmare is attacking the World Tree and find a way to stop the unthinkably huge beast!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2cba6432534dcd64750115b5f39a8e63c280d58e.jpg

The Dream Plane

Have you ever had a dream where you were in your house but it wasn't YOUR house? You know that you live there but it looks nothing like the house you really live in?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/08498293949ff2ba6c055feebe8910763c590b0d.jpg

PRO TIP - Follow the Bird Tracks
Trust us on this one...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0aeac7bc3b6fa7a8d31c92565da23659889a2889.jpg

Much like the elemental crossplanes, the Dream Plane is a kind of reflection of our world where things might look the same but things work very differently. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c9ab4b5075ff87f5f7869715bdf5180e641b591b.jpg

NEW GEAR! Aspect Masks, Dream Warden and More!

There's lot of new gear in this release and you can craft ALL of it! No drops other than crafting materials and no cosmetics that you can only buy with Dragon Crystals! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/47bd7801dbbef88d3f6f4e7c5e0ac8482ccf069b.jpg

Masks of the Aspects
Using the gems you can also craft each of the four masks worn by the elemental Aspects, Axas, Zolin, Pahua and Snek. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c2b235e1fe5e7e005145a5f5d1cdb2cf840b2346.jpg

Blade of Ancestors, Elemental Axe, & Dream Warden Robes
You will also be able to craft the basic Dream Warden robes, belt, bracers and three mask options and the Blade and Ancestors and Elemental Axe! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5c539226357e6efeea45ea17abeab135ac83e77f.gif

A Note To Slifsgaard

As some of you know, this release is one of the two releases designed by our Top Tier Kickstarter Backers who each got to design a weapon, their own NPC and were invited to the lab and work with us to design a whole area and story for you guys to play through.

We weren't sure what we were getting ourselves into when we offered this option. We were bringing in fans with no professional game development experience who might have demands that were completely impossible. They might want to reach too far and break the world we wanted to build or make it harder to tell the stories we're telling... but non of that happened. 

When Slifsgaard came to the lab he let us know what he really just wanted to make something that the fans of our games, fans like himself, have enjoyed for years. He had amazing ideas that were cool and fun but not over-reaching, his vision was really in line with what AQ3D was already working toward and he was very easy to work with!

Any community, online or otherwise, will have some rotten apples but it's really great to know that the Artix Entertainment Community composed of fans like Slifsgaard who are not here to start drama or bring anybody down... but just like the games and want to make sure everyone else does too. 

Thanks, Slifsgaard, for sharing your shamanic ideas and your World Tree with us. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: The World Tree is LIVE!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d17b0545250660c7bb4d032d4c09198442d210e7.jpg

Want to become a spirit raven and soar between the elemental planes? It is finally here-- explore the World Tree in AdventureQuest 3D. The Shaman, Slifsgaard, has a vision about you. You are about to begin a journey that will reveal who you really are. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1e302dec25d30514119158163e8c4549daba59f1.jpg

Explore strange places, unlock new titles, & find secret chests
We hid 3 new exploration points for you to find that unlock titles. Also, you may discover a few secret boxes. One containing, "The best backstory I never knew I needed to read" - Player on Twitter

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8fae03ff8f4eb2306a50311c6a0b013f7426fbf8.jpg

Become a Spirit Raven... find secrets. 
This release uses our newest feature to allow all players to transform into something special to explore the World Tree and traverse the mysterious elemental planes. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1f61bfcb79046025d630101682eaaeb459d51f9c.jpg

New Drops & Gear to Craft
After a series of releases full of darkness and skulls, this new release brings us back to color and nature --with skulls!


Spiritual Warrior Set
Soothsayer Set
Jagulope Set (half Jaguar... half Jackalope?) 
New travel forms
Spirit Animal Helms (Unlock after you beat the story)
Unusual new items to find and upgrade --with skulls!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b69a2fc38f6984d2ed4a52980e6e6c955367929b.jpg

The 4 Elemental Aspects
In this new story you will be tested by the very personifications of the elements. They also have AWESOME masks. Plot aside, next we will probably beat them up for them... just saying. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a1ea60697b34eb7694cfbab038edbb8cdd6ac13a.jpg

Meet Slifsgaard the Shaman
QUEST! Say that name 5 times fast O_O Pronounced "Slif's Guard"
This adventure was designed by Slifsgaard, the first of our two "World Designer" backers from the Kickstarter. He visited the lab, helped design the release, and we had a day long face-time where he launched the release with the team-- even joined us on a live stream of the release with Massively Overpowered. He is a great guy in real life, and was most focused on us creating something fun and special for you. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ee13b18f1f87bc2ef9d2c237dc57db7c0f0a3fae.png

Thank you... and next week is Friday the 13th!
We really hope you enjoy the World Tree. It has a little something in it for everyone. Next week, is Friday the 13th! Shrade and a new Campgonnagetcha (redesigned so the cabins are the same distance) will appear. On monday we will be officially posting the two new team mascots and their banners. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/59e8a05af4c3b56d14033b58e5f642428f8d96f0.jpg

Then, the follow week we will launch part 2, the finale, of the World Tree. This will feature new cutscenes, the Elemental Axe, the masks of the Elemental Aspects, and-- I just want to say this right now, the Dream Plane is going to hands down be the most interesting map we have ever put in the game. It is insane.

Battle on!
Artix & The AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Beat the Ogreman!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2056a8a5cb12f2e2a35f5811c9803e0ac810cd6a.jpg

Read the full design notes post at https://aq3d.com/news/ogreman/ 

"Me Ogreman, me smash gud!"

Beware! Blue ogres have been spotted wreaking havok in the town of Battleon. Join us for this weekend's special community mini-event with GameOgre.com featuring cat ears, ogre items (including a consumable that transforms you into a blue ogre), and more!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d24f3e4b0b7a50d7ba604f18fa8d3e216d5b690d.jpg

Cat Ears “Battle Meow-n!"

Want cat ears for your hero? You can now use the gems you get from doing random adventures to craft different color ears at Cysero’s forge. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c1f615aa70aa811b8aaa6c9b59b8b6a1ecefa05f.jpg

New Akriloth Craft Recipes

We have been reading your messages! Having a hard time getting those super rare drops off the toughest version of the Akriloth Fire Dragon boss fight? You can now, alternatively, craft them on Senna. So if you are really, really, really, really unlucky.... you can still ultimately get the item your fiery heart most desires. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a89135d6b19484a457a24ba17648cad2bc984421.jpg

Your Collections now available at the Bank!

You can now access all of your collections at the bank. Hootenhiem thinks this is a lot safer than keeping them in Melodia’s closet at the Inn… which is really funny if you think about it. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7d553586a9280e311e3389ccec6f6d877d613537.jpg

Class Balancing... no, this is good news!

Normally I get scared when I hear the word “balancing” from game devs.


Mages now do a little more damage
DragonSlayers now do more damage to Dragons
Guardian skills now require less mana


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9e058f5d03fa64662df2dcbbc4369841b2252a70.jpg

Thank you & Shaman Area Coming Next!

"Is it a Kickstarter only area? No! It is for everyone. A Kickstarter actually backer paid us to make this next release for you. Seriously."

The next major AdventureQuest 3D release is the Tree of Life-- and based on what I have seen from the story, art, characters, new feature, and loot it is really going to surprise you. Originally scheduled for this week, we pushed it back so we had the extra time to finish it right. So, this weekend, we hope you enjoy the special release! Time to fight some ogres and get cat ears….

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. There is also a secret /join GameOgre map if you are looking for a real challenge.
P.P.S. We have been reading the "click loot bag" issues and will prioritize the fix for this.  The good news is the same items drop on the blue ogres  in town. So, if you cannot get the loot from the special map-- just head to town to do battle.
More News

notes.title: Earn New Titles & Badges!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ff08d2768b319c9f45cd28fbc6b78bdf8c6511a4.jpg

See the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/newtitles/

Get rewarded for exploring all those strange places!

In this week's new release we added tons of new titles & badges.... you can earn and unlock them by exploring strange places, battling challenge boss fights, and more! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f10666a971c6088c221e007d32a08ab1e8baa1bb.jpg

Boss Challenge Titles

These titles can be unlocked from finding or fighting special boss monsters. The names should help you figure out which ones give the titles.

    Brutal Bro
    Frogzard Hunter
    So Shelfish
    IT'S ALL TRUE!
    Terrorized
    Dreadly Serious
    The Unburned
    Winged It
    Kaiju Killer

Exploration Titles

These titles can be earned by finding secret Exploration Scrolls around the world. When you go off the beaten path... or climb over it... a secret scroll may suddenly reveal itself. Walk over it to unlock a new Badge & Title! (Exploration Achievement Unlocked!) The names may help give clues on where to look.

    River Stone
    Death's Hand
    Spelunker
    Freeclimber
    NecroKnighted
    Infernal Tourist
    Tavern Patron
    Dimwitted
    Master of the Tower (Guardian only)


Loyalty

These badges/titles come from supporting the game or participating in our ongoing releases. There are a lot more than the ones listed, but I am keeping this list to the ones that are currently available.

    Open Beta Hero (Everyone will get this soon)
    Founder
    Guardian
    Dragon Guardian

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b644d51b2797e2024a90239830bf838bbe2b1b0d.jpg

HeroMart

Many things form our online shop, https://www.HeroMart.com , will now unlock titles & badges in AdventureQuest 3D. We are going to try to do a little database magic to retroactively give you badges for things you have already redeemed in game. This will probably happen by the end of next week. So if you see a bunch of new titles suddenly appear on your account, you will know why!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4f8ed3af4a306d1f1b3ea45f70faf13182039c21.jpg

More Titles Coming

Good hunting in finding the new in-game titles! With each release we will be adding more... rewarding the bold and brave explorers who search every nook and cranny of a new area. I suspect that not all future titles will be announced. Also... check out the sneak peak of the upcoming Shaman area. Battle on!

notes.title: Dage the Evil's Underworld Gate
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d578e3122f9e41f2308bacf69c395883b5aa6757.jpg

New Area, Story, Parkour, and Loot
Dage is master of the Undead Legion. You have heard his name. But you have never heard his story... until now. There is a mysterious stranger named Vost in town whom you should speak with immediately. He claims to have discovered a way to the UnderWorld. Is he just obsessed with learning more about Dage and his Undead Legion-- or is something more going on here?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2ad5ae0b1983e01602533554b5cfbb3152fdb892.jpg

The armors above are drops (or from crafting)

This new AdventureQuest 3D release has something special for everyone. The armors and weapons in the screenshot above are some of the drops and craftable items that you can earn. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/40ca8a1faa161d0023f558eda0b6f6ee2c24eddf.jpg

Under Guardian Armor
"Even the Underworld has Guardians"

notes.title: Potions for Gold, Death, Doomwood, & stuffs!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/696043d42512519382820e7fdb5a89a6c7ffb60b.png

Greetings friends!

We hope you are enjoying the Dragons of Ashfall: Part 3 release and boss fights! After reading the latest reviews, we made some changes and restarted the server just a bit ago to apply them

1. Potions for Gold!
You can now buy Health Potions for 90 gold from the quick potions menu. Hope this helps in your coming battles.

2. DoomWood Monster Nerf!
A lot of players are leveling up to get to play the newest adventures Ashfall. But to do so... they have to slog through the dreaded DoomWood ("GrindWood") which was made an extremely long time ago (Before we had cutscenes, sagas, challenge fights, or any of the new features that players love.) So... guess which zone I will be re-writing this weekend?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e13d88a90e6cdf6425a3680567b521e27f547cd6.jpg

To help the players leveling up now, I took the nerf hammer to a lot of the monsters in that area. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/78799f2cfe57ecdbe284b1b7f9373b252b487056.jpg

3. Custom Weapon Backers got their codes!
You may have seen some unusual weapons in game. Our Kickstarter Custom Weapon backers received their codes this week. Originally they were supposed to get 10, but we gave them 12 for being so awesome and patient. I will be rebooting the server one more time (waiting till super late so we do not disturb your game playing) to fix some of the items. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9a10b7d154bf9ea8fa6c591969e563c9b36d801e.jpg

Just a preview... DEATH SCREEN
I miss the old DEATH and his witty banter. So Dage drew this up and we are currently working on getting it in the game. Having a speech bubble will allow DEATH to tell you if special "death rules" are in effect-- like in Extreme Mode dungeons were you cannot re-spawn until your party clears the room. Maybe we can add secret death quests? 

Battle on!
Artix

notes.title: Dragons of Ashfall: Part III is LIVE!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/951c9953272fcdb6915a0548715fbad529d3d103.jpg
Watch the trailer

Join the DragonSlayers on their Ultimate Hunt!

"Happy Valantines Day! ...and there is nothing a DragonSlayer loves more than hunting dragons."
At long last, it is time to enter the dragon's lair!  Watch the teaser Ashfall 3 trailer, then join the DragonSlayer's as they raid the Dragon's Lair. You can now become a Dragonslayer... level up to 20.... and experience our first ever 20-player Raid Boss Fight!

Read the full design notes post

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b40191d1004aa8bf0d7bb4c6b9101bd7c5fb03c2.jpg

Watch the Ashfall: Part 3 Teaser Trailer

"Previously, on the Dragons of Ashfall"
Watch the video for the story so far. At the heart of the volcano, sleeps a Great Dragon. It is more massive than any dragon you have seen in our world. Our enemy, Talyn, plans to awaken the beast and control it. To awaken the Great Dragon from it's slumber he must gather four tributes: food, gold, an army, and a magical artifact known as... the Fire Orb. As you read this, Talyn has already entered the volcano. He must be stopped...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d4a7707742eb1bec6877a6a329e46bc46507e48.jpg

New in this AdventureQuest 3D release!

    DragonSlayer Class - all players can now earn the dragon slayer class
    DragonSlayer Gear
    Daily Quests
    Ashfall: Part III Story
    New Boss Fight Mechanics
    5 and 20 player Boss Raid Challenge
    75 new equippable items
    5 cinematic cutscenes (way to go Korin!)
    14 dialog cutscenes
    The snow melts in Battleon (Drooster returns)
    Level Cap increased to 20

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/eb019713d468a247d88776d23ccfba1d94ab4c3d.jpg

Become a DragonSlayer!

All players can now earn the DragonSlayer Class
DragonSlayers are the elite hunters of Dragons. Their skills are finely honed giving them bonuses when battling dragonkind. Now, ALL PLAYERS, can earn the DragonSlayer class by doing storyline and daily quests to earn DragonSlayer Tokens. Talk to Galanoth in Ashfall to get started!
Read the official post on how to become a DragonSlayer. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8d00c92f065f3a29518e729a43c275478e3779b6.jpg

Earn DragonSlayer Gear!

Once you are a DragonSlayer, you can continue earning tokens to unlock exclusive class gear including Galanoth's helmet and yes... oh yes... the legendary Dragon's Blade. We built this shop like the collections we released in the holiday. Which means once you unlock an item, you will have permanent access and be able to re-get it whenever you want. for 0 gold-- saving you that precious inventory space.  

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/28b131402c258e798eb0adf5034a6a1945c23c8d.jpg

Battle along side the DragonSlayers....

In this epic finale to the Dragons of Ashfall Saga, you will battle alongside Galanoth, Kord, Senna and Gibbs. Each of these dragonslayers has a motivation for defeating Talyn, or the Great Dragon at the heart of the volcano. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/51f2a5c4902b03c9a7781248e148c3893130d67e.jpg

This story will impact the characters in our other games.
...and now you know. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/13d004356e6425c2b5bc8e5b4bfe292a8aa06c48.jpg

Crafting and Ashfall Daily Quests

Once you complete the story, you will unlock new craftable items. Be sure to check in with Senna, the DragonSlayer's Quartermaster to see all of the sets which include...

    Dragon Champion (Full set)
    Dragon Berserker (Full set)
    Pheonix Knight (Full set)
    Fire Mage (Full set)
    Fire Rogue (Full set)
    Talyn's Armor (Full set)
    Ebon Talyn Vault (VERY EXPENSIVE.... Full Set)
    DragonSlayer Gear (DragonSlayer Tokens)
    ...also, there are secret drops.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/751fc23aa0d204c73bfeb10fec4a2178d63254f5.jpg

Level Cap increased to 20!

Reaching level 20 will unlock our first raid boss fight.

5-Player & 20-Player BOSS RAID CHALLENGE!

Bring your friends and prepare for the most challenging battle in AdventureQuest 3D yet. You will all need to be max level and fully decked out. Unlike the single player boss fight, the enemy will not telegraph their attacks. So be sure to practice. I wish I could show you a screenshot of the actual fight (The screenshot above is from the first room of the story).... but Cysero told me if I posted any spoilers he would re-arrange my DNA. Check back in a few days for a post on "DEATH".

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4eafdbfee46f891989e75ba7b8b6c5f91083a804.jpg

Thank you... and prepare for the Dragon's Lair!

It has taken nearly a year to create the tools, systems, and processes that allow us to create amazing adventures and stories like Ashfall Part III. This is a special release for both the players and the team. Thank you for your loyalty, encouragement, and passion for our world. This release marks the start of many new epic adventures together (...and ones that will come much faster, LOL!) 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg

Coming next!

Next week we will release those two dungeons to the right and left at the top of Mount Ashfall. Then, it is time for Dage's birthday-- a gateway will open to new area of the Underworld. Heroes should be advised to be weary of signing any "contracts" in the underworld. Then the Shaman Forest and Dragon's Graveyard will quickly follow. Check our homepage daily for the newest design notes on our progress.... Oh! Every Monday we update the GAME PLAN. Feels pretty good that we knocked a few items off of that list already. It has only bee a week since it was posted.

Now, DragonSlayers...
"It is time to enter the dragon's lair and take Talyn down... BATTLE ON!"

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bd26a860bb548a9ec92c89ed85ae2e0afe4eb67c.jpg

Watch the trailer

notes.title: The Order of Dragon Slayers
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3d760b2c2935575813e7ce8a18497c492290f2e3.jpg

The DragonSlayers are an elite order of dragon hunters

Early next week, you will join the DragonSlayers in their ultimate challenge... entering the dragon infested volcano in "The Dragons of Ashfall: Part III". If you have not played parts one and two yet, this weekend is your chance to catch up and be part of the raid when it launches!

Read the FULL DESIGN NOTES POST on DragonSlayers

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7b9c11ede815138c919338f47a6fe9c9dcf4bc43.jpg
Galanoth
Leader of the DragonSlayers
Everyone has heard of the DragonSlayer's iconic and heavily armored leader, Galanoth. He wields the legendary sword, the Dragon Blade. However, no one has ever seen his face*. Stoic and obsessed with eliminating the the threat of dragons, he is a man of a single purpose. Now, Galanoth prepares to lead the DragonSlayers on the ultimate hunt, deep in the heart of Ashfall's volcano. Want to join them?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg
Talyn
Evil Lord of Dragons
Legend says there are amulets that grant the power to control dragons. Talyn possesses such an amulet. How he got it is a mystery. However, what he intends to do with it has become horrifyingly clear. See, a DragonAmulet does far more than just allow someone to control dragons. Its ultimate ability allows you to bind yourself to a dragon. This bond is for life. It grants both the owner of the amulet, and their dragon, incredible powers and abilities.  Talyn used his amulet to do this once... but his dragon has been slain*. He is clearly seeking a new dragon, but not just any dragon. At the heart of Ashfall's volcano sleeps an Great Dragon. It is MASSIVE. It is SMART. It is... well, best left asleep. Few people in the world have ever laid eyes on a Great Dragon and lived to tell the tale. Galanoth and his second in command, Kord, have. A Great Fire Dragon. The same one Talyn is going to try to awaken and bind himself to in the volcano... 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/323e45ce23e059e86101f58abce0b226cafe2206.jpg
Kord
2nd in Command of the DragonSlayers
Kord is strong, loyal, and charismatic commander. He is the glue which keeps the order of DragonSlayers together. He would have to be, because Galanoth can really come off as a dragon obsessed jerk. You could make a strong argument that there would not even be an Order of DragonSlayers without Kord. As new recruits flock to the iconic Galanoth because of his fame and legend-- Kord is the one who finds them a place within the DragonSlayer's ranks. Perhaps you had a similar experience when joining the DragonSlayers? Kord is one of the original members. Why is he so loyal to Galanoth? Well, Galanoth saved him when a Great Fire Dragon destroyed his home town, leaving him orphaned. Kord was just a boy back then-- and despite Galanoth's repeated attempts to shoo him away, Kord refused to leave his side. He became an expert at slaying dragons... and Galanoth's trusted, right hand man.

Galanoth
Leader of the DragonSlayers
Everyone has heard of the DragonSlayer's iconic and heavily armored leader, Galanoth. He wields the legendary sword, the Dragon Blade. However, no one has ever seen his face*. Stoic and obsessed with eliminating the the threat of dragons, he is a man of a single purpose. Now, Galanoth prepares to lead the DragonSlayers on the ultimate hunt, deep in the heart of Ashfall's volcano. Want to join them?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/05246e34a3188cea7029b01bd49f35b7f3d5d414.jpg

Evil Lord of Dragons
Legend says there are amulets that grant the power to control dragons. Talyn possesses such an amulet. How he got it is a mystery. However, what he intends to do with it has become horrifyingly clear. See, a DragonAmulet does far more than just allow someone to control dragons. Its ultimate ability allows you to bind yourself to a dragon. This bond is for life. It grants both the owner of the amulet, and their dragon, incredible powers and abilities.  Talyn used his amulet to do this once... but his dragon has been slain*. He is clearly seeking a new dragon, but not just any dragon. At the heart of Ashfall's volcano sleeps an Great Dragon. It is MASSIVE. It is SMART. It is... well, best left asleep. Few people in the world have ever laid eyes on a Great Dragon and lived to tell the tale. Galanoth and his second in command, Kord, have. A Great Fire Dragon. The same one Talyn is going to try to awaken and bind himself to in the volcano... 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/323e45ce23e059e86101f58abce0b226cafe2206.jpg

2nd in Command of the DragonSlayers
Kord is strong, loyal, and charismatic commander. He is the glue which keeps the order of DragonSlayers together. He would have to be, because Galanoth can really come off as a dragon obsessed jerk. As new recruits flock to the iconic Galanoth because of his fame and legend-- Kord is the one who finds them a place within the DragonSlayer's ranks. Well, Galanoth saved him when a Great Fire Dragon destroyed his home town, leaving him orphaned. notes.title: The Mouse Hole - Our Smallest Adventure Ever!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e9812eeac615ed7129efb82dd462dc74559e4e03.jpg
Read the full post at https://aq3d.com/news/mousehole/

Just released!
Did you ever notice that little mouse hole in Yulgar’s Inn? What if you could find a way to shrink down to a tiny size and go in there? Well now you can. What could you possibly find? Parkour… strange loot... a Badge? Log in and find out!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9b054cfb860e6f36f14974ab296581a7aa104da9.jpg

Parkour!? Why do the Mice have a Parkour Course?
Keep your eyes open, and you will find a secret parkour course hidden in this new adventure. The prize for reaching the top of the course? An exploration achievement badge! But... BE CAREFUL! When designing the course, Yergen deviously add some MwP “Mess with Players” mechanics. This will allow you to do terrible things to your fellow micro-ninja-warriors.

CHALLENGE - Can you beat Cysero’s fastest time of 1 minute and 30 seconds? Tweet @ArtixKrieger and @Cysero YouTube link or it did not happen :D

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/60d436994ca5d574c1fb6e12abaae8931d198710.jpg

Travel Form Foods & Potions
New Feature! You can now craft a piece of cheese that will transform you into, um, something... “Squeek!” This is a consumable “single use” item. And yes, everyone is able to make some cheese through regular game play in this adventure. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f152ecc7f4b1150ca5e15622ffc10287473a94aa.jpg
 
“Rats off to the Vurrmen artist!”
The Vurrmen are a race of giant rat monsters that first appeared in our 2D web game, DragonFable. Who would have believed back in 2007 as artist/ninja Thyton was drawing it, that he would be involved in creating a 3D version of it today! Granted, the Vurrmen are still small and rat sized at this point in the game’s story. But if you can become small… what is stopping them from finding a way to become big? Beware the Vurrmenator.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/110a31c53b139052d28099a64ee3354fd99bbd2f.jpg

Sneak Peek of Ashfall: Part III armors
The wait is nearly over. Korin is finishing the last 2 incredible, fully animated cutscenes. Until then, here is a sneak peek of the Dragon Beserker armor sets that you will earn from battling the Great Dragon at the heart of Ashfall’s volcano. Yes, these armors will use your skin color.'

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4f1dbab8b5a541951af49dea67fbc61b43e21386.jpg

The Game Plan
Over 2,000 players gave their deepest thoughts about AdventureQuest 3D to a survey that deep down inside they figured no one would read. SURPRISE! We did. All of them O_O. Read everything we learned and our new game plan.


“10/10! A really gouda release!”
“Love the occasional cheesy storyline!”
“5 Stars! Can’t believe they squeaked out this release in time for the weekend!”
“For their smallest release ever.. it is pretty big!”


Thank you & Say Cheese!
The mouse hole was a fan favorite adventure from the original 2D AdventureQuest. It was one of those strange and memorable things that gave the game its charm. We are excited to see if you can find the way into our re-imagined adventure… maybe the Warlic in the magic shop can help? The Mouse Hole is available now, and it is the first of several adventures coming to new Yulgar’s Inn.

Thank you to everyone who has been encouraging and supporting AdventureQuest 3D’s development. If you are not already a Guardian, please consider supporting the game’s on going releases with a one-time upgrade.

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Mice

notes.title: Frostlorn Raiders Invade Town!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f733a0d71a3f526a9fa233498e682a2c33264110.jpg
Full post at https://www.aq3d.com/news/frostlorn-raiders/

Frostlorn Raiders invade town!
Who do these Frostlorn Raiders think they are?! Just as the worst snowstorm we have ever seen hits our home town of Battleon, they waltz in with their weapons drawn. We thought they needed help.  As our friends rushed out to assist them... they were struck down in cold blood, then they unleashed their army of frost monsters. Even as you read this, these icy abominations are attacking our shops and people. Defender Roland has declared an emergency and re-formed the Battleon Militia-- we need your help. Come quickly! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ef0e2d6048e9d8ff7e1ee8d545f487f22cc3907d.jpg
Frostval returns with seasonal loot drops and crafting!
They will only be here for a short time. Login and battle to get your festive “O’Tannenbush” travel form, ugly sweater capes, Yettun horns, Frostlorn items, Frost Defender Armor, Elf Armors, Santa Armor (cannot believe Dage & Yergen got this finished in time), wrapped weapons, festive scarves, and other items. Oh, and Guardians... the Raiders are dropping a Rudolf the Reindragon travel form just for you.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fba3d3c42fc1cba0c4e047f224cf7c9327bc6291.jpg
The Frost Labyrinth
The Yettun has returned and the Frost Labyrinth is open! Battle through the Frost Labyrinth to defeat the Yettun and restore the Frost Moglins to the land they lost so long ago. Talk to Blizzy, the light blue moglin near the Travel Crystal in Battleon, to being your adventure. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5fde128c8783a0ac87e0da4bad324b8249b0ab87.jpg
The 2017 Frostval Collection
The first ever Frostval Collection is now available! Talk to the little blue moglin Blizzy in Battleon to get the new items individually, or get the ENTIRE 2017 Frostval Collection (save about 45%)! 

What is included in the Collection?
The collection includes a rare badge, permanent, free access to the items year round (freeing up your inventory space) including both snowman travel forms, and that warm and fuzzy feeling from knowing that you are directly supporting AdventureQuest 3D’s ongoing development. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/58c1bb76cfd137aac64d1bf7b88becf7261b0274.jpg
New Yulgar’s Inn
Town is not the only place getting into the holiday spirit. Yulgar & Melodia just finished decorating the new and improved Inn. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0626085e9fe8c3e6ed7863010897cfa9321e0936.jpg
“There is so much stuff to do, but all I want to do is hang out in this cozy inn!” - a player
Come in from the cold, have a seat and warm up! Seriously, you can sit in the chairs now and the Inn’s new music is beautiful. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0dad790d00f88aa1a0cdc9f17a249891737be056.jpg
HeroMart
Check out the new stuff at  www.HeroMart.com including the Ugly Sweater T-Shirt and our 2018 Calendar. And if you were studying this photo closely, um, yes, we decorated the lab’s tree with an Alien facehugger. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c43eb10435e0515b70225cacc4506480760b135b.jpg
Next Week… Frostlorn Boss Raid! 
The Frostlorn Raiders have three leaders…. Faustbite, Phrozen, and Sleet. Think you and your friends can take them on in a group vs group fight? We are going to find out. Next week, to bring in the new year, we are releasing a special 10-player raid map where you will battle them! You will also get the chance to craft the Frostlorn Mage and Rogue armor sets!

Thank You for 15 Years of Adventure
We hope you are enjoying this wintery, frostval release. While the team was finishing it up, I made you a special 15th anniversary cape. It will be available for you in game next week. It symbolizes, without question, our community and team’s most significant achievement together. Pouring your life and soul into something for 15 years is a really big deal. What is important about this is not the number, but the dedication, passion, and loyalty that it represents. When you consider that the original AdventureQuest has been updated every single week for over 15 years-- it makes you stop and think “how can someone love these games that much?” Of course, YOU know. Because, if you are reading this, you do too. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33090f67d27b97a719a96cbd6afba066bb81c264.jpg

From all of us here at the Artix Entertainment “Secret Underground Lab”, we wish you, your family and your friends all the happiness, joy, warmth and fun to be had in this holiday season. 

Happy Frostval & Battle on!
Artix & The Merry AdventureQuest 3D Team

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c43eb10435e0515b70225cacc4506480760b135b.jpg
Next Week… Frostlorn Boss Raid! 
The Frostlorn Raiders have three leaders…. Faustbite, Phrozen, and Sleet. Think you and your friends can take them on in a group vs group fight? We are going to find out. Next week, to bring in the new year, we are releasing a special 10-player raid map where you will battle them! You will also get the chance to craft the Frostlorn Mage and Rogue armor sets!

Thank You for 15 Years of Adventure
We hope you are enjoying this wintery, frostval release. While the team was finishing it up, I made you a special 15th anniversary cape. It will be available for you in game next week. What is important about this is not the number, but the dedication, passion, and loyalty that it represents. Because, if you are reading this, you do too. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/33090f67d27b97a719a96cbd6afba066bb81c264.jpg

From all of us here at the Artix Entertainment “Secret Underground Lab”, we wish you, your family and your friends all the happiness, joy, warmth and fun to be had in this holiday season. 

Happy Frostval & Battle on!
Artix & The Merry AdventureQuest 3D Team

notes.title: Darkovia Saga - Part 2 just released!
notes.content:

Read the full post here: http://www.aq3d.com/news/darkovia2/

The Darkovia Saga Part II is LIVE!
Whilst the war between Vampires and Werewolves rages on, a young life hangs in the balance… and only you are brave enough (or crazy enough) to journey deep into a forest drenched in the curse of eternal darkness to search for a fabled cure. The gate is now open… join us in-game as we explore the forest of Darkovia!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bc2777e5686c35f02f3a37f9672797cb870de1c1.jpg

Darker Monsters
Beware! There are far more deadly creatures than just Vampires and Werewolves in Darkovia forest. Take the Terrortoma for example… our top candidate for this year’s valentines card cover.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3770cda3d877ccbf25e91a174374841fa1bcd501.jpg

Darker Heroes
Meet little Dread. As Darkovia’s expert werewolf hunter speaks softly, and carries a BIG metal hand claw thing! Talk to her and perhaps she can help you on your quest. Or at the very least, let you craft your own claw.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/7bcd2c9c4c5eef11da535bc80abb7725c6b08c4d.jpg

Darker Bonus Challenge Fights
You better bring some friends-- once you discover the new challenge fights it will take team work to earn some of the games most interesting rewards.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/9ab37f0f4a22755c14ac893cea467d8502c93976.jpg

A guy in a tin foil hat
Hooper is probably crazy.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/0c71bb670240c6610ece8f0fa5b68e8a0beb0194.jpg

Darker Dungeons
Dive into Darkovia’s three new dungeons where gear and vampire fangs drop faster than our steam rating. At some point, you are going to wonder why there is a Vampire named David. Then you are going to Google it and go, “Ooooh… I see what you did there.”

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2175c3c869a28f06d12f8dc174864bb19752ab7a.jpg

The Darkest Darkovia!
We hope you enjoy the Darkovia Part II story and are excited for the Vampire Castle and Werewolf Lair that will open when the story continues. Next week, however, the weather-moglin says to expect snow in the town of Battleon! But this weekend… we descend into the darkness! See you in game.

Battle on!
Artix & AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. You can get to Darkovia from the travel crystal or your travel menu.
P.P.S. This weekend I am making a trailer for Darkovia (both, parts I & II). So if you see me running around, I am probably recording-- fight your hardest!
P.P.PS. http://www.HeroMart.com has Vamp and Lycan shirts in, also the Calendar.

notes.title: You just got +10 Inventory Spaces!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3ac870b19a69b3efa99e7dee33713a9da546bb4b.jpg

EVERYONE gets 10 more Inventory Spaces

We heard you were running out of room, so we just added 10 more inventory spaces to your character’s backpack :D This should help a little with your storage needs while we work on a few longer term solutions to free up your main inventory space. Enjoy!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b5a92b1ac539ce306e0734f5cb085eceef7315e4.jpg

Coming next in AdventureQuest 3D

Darkovia is currently open now for all players. Next up, the saga continues in Part II which leads us deep into Darkovia’s Forest where you will encounter a Werewolf Hunter named Little Dread-- and search for the forest’s most carefully guarded secret. Meanwhile, the newest version of the game has been submitted which will bring new features and squish a good number of bugs. Finally, we have a 1st draft of the DragonSlayer class that we are experimenting with. As promised, Legendary Backers are going to get first shot at trying it out soon. Ashfall Part III’s cinematics are making good progress. We will need to do one of those “Last time, on DragonFable Z” style recap videos before you go into the finale so the plot is fresh in your mind. Finally, OMG I cannot wait until you see the Vampire King’s castle-- I can see the throne room on Llussion’s screen from where I am sitting and it is amazing. Maybe I should post a sneak peek ealry next week. For the latest news and updates, be sure to keep an eye on my regular design notes posts here.

Read more at http://www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Darkovia! Vampires vs Werewolves
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b5a92b1ac539ce306e0734f5cb085eceef7315e4.jpg

Read the full news at http://www.aq3d.com/news/darkovialive/

In Darkovia, a land cursed by eternal darkness, the vampires and werewolves have locked fangs in a deadly war. But why is their conflict centered on the small town of Darkhurst? Does it possess a secret or some sort of terrible prize? A ShadowSlayer has appeared in town to help protect the townsfolk-- but in a conflict of this size, they cannot do it alone!


 Level Cap Raised to 18
 Town of Darkhurst
 Boog's Tavern - sit in the chairs!
 21 Dialog Cutscenes
 ShadowSlayer side quests-- unlock E's gear
 Book of Darkov side quests - secrets and lore
 New weapons, armor, and items


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bbd34a3b69d3467cea1e7a2e96b622034b15ff8e.jpg

The ShadowSlayer
“I stalk the creatures that stalk the night.”
You will meet ShadowStalker W, Lore's foremost expert vampire slayer & werewolf hunter. W is the 23rd of his line and ever willing to help the victims of these creatures-- for a price. Earn his trust and begin your training as a ShadowSlayer unlocking vampire and werewolf hunting gear. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2d7004beb269c6bef9fb26e009f7a594ba976c74.jpg

Boog’s Tavern
“Wait, we can actually sit in the chairs now?”
Part 1 of the Darkovia Saga is extremely story focused, setting our new record of TWENTY-TWO dialogue cutscenes and introducing a cast of interesting and “a wee bit doomed” characters. Also, yes, you can sit in the chairs. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/11c18d4fcf1645a7467e207ab581b03b1ab824e4.jpg

More Darkovia to sink your fangs into...
We really hope you enjoy this first part of the Darkovia Saga. The next exciting release continues where this one leaves off... granting you access to Darkovia Forest. We wrote the story arc in such a way that after Part II, we can switch back to the highly anticipated conclusion of our previous area, Ashfall. Which means, as you are reading this, Korin is animating the cinematic cutscenes for The Dragons of Ashfall: Part III while Rabblefroth is working on the DragonSlayer class!  We are also building several new features (which you can easily guess at) for the future parts of Darkovia which will make it really interesting when you can side with the Vamps and Lycans (Werewolves).

Read more news at http://www.AQ3D.com

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/096e51d8041970ae34ec6f410bb5f7587d239fc3.jpg

Combat overhaul is a literal "Game Changer"
Read the full story at http://www.aq3d.com/news/improvedclasses/

Login on any device and play the new & improved Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian classes. They now feature unique play styles with new skills, animated FX, and ULTIMATES!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/01252a4dee5b4eeb60b27aae09f2c6fe73652501.jpg

Login and see for yourself, or read on for the juicy details.

notes.title: Mogloween is LIVE!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4ef47ccdfe0186a0e6648b367a92b5528b5eff24.jpg

Mogloween has begun!

Enter the haunted Mystcroft Manor... if you dare. ...Insert sinister "MWAHAHAHAHA" laughter here... How? Speak with that talking cauldron named Myx in town

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/021986fab5d8ea88e333af3e5b9313db7cfa48d8.jpg

Pumpkinmancer (NEW!)

Ambitious adventurous will quest to unlock all wings of the haunted mansion and craft this year's new seasonal rare set-- Pumpkinmancer! There is also a Pumpkin Scythe and a Shadow variant of the helm.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/566ebb028f4b0e4a6e1089b350d8bbf8e7e9d916.jpg

Mystcroft manor now has a map of its own... 


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe64e066870b9113dcc6d4709f49a581ca5554ff.jpg

"OH! YEAH! NOOO!"

OK, we seriously need a meme of Myx busting through a wall yelling "OH! NOOO!" This talking black cauldron is always brewing up trouble... evil pumpkin spice flavored trouble. Someone (or thing) placed him in our freshly decorated town. Talk to him to travel to Mystcroft Manor, Camp Gonnagetcha, get the 2017 Mogloween Collector's Edition, and more. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/00d959d831446c4230f826ee2b9cd32a86196a44.jpg

Mogloween 2017 Collection

Our 1st ever Mogloween collection features brand new items, armor, and two travel forms-- Skeleton and Lil’ Skelly! Both which run at 130% travel speed. Get the items separately, or get the ENTIRE Mogloween 2017 collection which  includes a rare badge, permanent access to the items which frees up your inventory space, will save you a coffin-load of (30% off = Save 2,200 DCs), and you are directly supporting AQ3D’s ongoing development.

Happy Mogloween!

Mogloween and the loot you can obtain in it is only available once a year for a limited time... and that time is now. Mystcroft Manor is vastly superior to last year. You will not fall through any *coughs* trap doors. (Last year, we used to fall straight through the map under certain situations) The Haunted Manor is now scaling allowing all players to play together. Furthermore, there is a level 12+ requirement for the higher level challenge wing Which means no level 1 players can wander in and stay there, making it impossible to clear the room. But if you do need to go, you can now leave the house at any time by existing through the red glowly indicators on the floor. The new quest systems will make it very clear where to go. Because we used a new quest chain, everyone will play from the start-- but it does not take very long.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/72eba2eabd414ed13e2c3bfa466ba82c0d5ac65d.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f98ebaadadf5727f05cbde760a602934a0dee999.jpg



Happy haunting heroes!

notes.title: LIVE! Friday the 13th War & Mogloween
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2771d67b141058f695205acb07e4d2ef3c13712a.jpg

LIVE! Friday the 13th War & Mogloween

“The smell of pumpkin spice and doom surrounds you.”
Happy Friday the 13th! Log and join everyone in AdventureQuest 3D as we kick off our trilogy of dark releases. Starting with a thriller double feature!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/5edec8335c8e2a95db6dc6b542dec6702208d35f.jpg

Town has been redecorated for Mogloween and the haunted house is about to open-- right after one side wins our 1st head-to-head war in the grand opening of Camp Gonnagetcha! So… which side will you fight for?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fa481d53b01f61dbbf80844fdecda7a19be5a028.jpg

Camp Gonnagetcha

We are putting the campy back in the iconic "B-Horror" Camp experience. Just remember the 3 simple rules for surviving a scary movie

No kissy-kissy face
Stay off the Moglinberry Juice
NEVER… EVER… say “I’ll be right back.”


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1852643138f3cbcabe39449b7aeb361839d69644.jpg

The Return of Shrade

Everyone’s favorite psychopathic, machete wielding, hockey loving, epic-horror-loot-pinata is back for a sequel. He’s got new art and loot-- you better bring some tough friends. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ad7b4353ab9440a9ad6730c249e029602d5f673b.jpg

WAR! Dricken vs Frogzard Cabin

Choose your side and become a part of AdventureQuest 3D history in our first two sided war! The first side to fill up their war meter in Camp Gonnagetcha will win, unlocking a Perma-rare black flag and opening the Haunted Mystcroft Manor for all players.

    Fight for Frogzard Cabin or Dricken Cabin
    The memes on Twitter have been hilarious
    Turn in war badges to help your side fill up their meter
    New craftable item(s) unlock at 25%
    New craftable armor(s) unlocks at 50%
    1st team to 100% wins
    Mogloween’s Mystcroft Manor will open!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f98ebaadadf5727f05cbde760a602934a0dee999.jpg

Mogloween’s Mystcroft Manor

Mystcroft Manor is home to witches, ghosts, shadow trickers, Pumpkin Lords, and the Elder Grourd, Gourd’thulu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/566ebb028f4b0e4a6e1089b350d8bbf8e7e9d916.jpg

It now has its own map, and a new pumpkin armor set, which will unlock after the camp war has been won!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b96640636a48837a0f3fb4bd3c078def8bf924d4.jpg

Darkovia

Coming next! The Vampires and Werewolves have locked fangs a bitter war over Darkovia-- a land consumed by eternal night. Can you save the small town caught between the ambitions of the Vampire King and Lycan Alpha? Things may go a little differently than you remembered in this re-imagining of the iconic AdventureQuest saga.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c19162ec4ed74fe009d6fe7257ecd6fa42739fa3.jpg

T-Shirts at HeroMart.com

Feel like taking this event a bit too far? For a VERY limited time, you can get Camp Gonnagetcha shirts from our online store, www.HeroMart.com . Says Camp Gonnagetcha with a “Hello! My name’s Shrade” name tag on the front, and your side’s team logo of your choice on the back.
Get one while you can

NOTE: Stryche (who runs the shop) asked me to let you know he has been working on reducing shipping costs.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/00d959d831446c4230f826ee2b9cd32a86196a44.jpg

Mogloween 2017 Collection

Our 1st ever Mogloween collection features brand new items, armor, and two travel forms-- Skeleton and Lil’ Skelly! Both which run at 130% travel speed. Get the items separately, or get the ENTIRE Mogloween 2017 collection which  includes a rare badge, permanent access to the items which frees up your inventory space, will save you a coffin-load of (30% off = Save 2,200 DCs), and you are directly supporting AQ3D’s ongoing development.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/abf34e691b66670c588857e58f9b4c14df48302d.jpg

Thank you & Happy 15th Anniversary

Thank you for being an important part of our game world and making this game happen. This time of the year is so much fun! We hope you enjoy the lineup of dark releases we are making for you-- both here and across our other Artix Entertainment video games.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fe64e066870b9113dcc6d4709f49a581ca5554ff.jpg

Time for war!
Myx the cauldron is in town waiting to take you to the war. Wait… did you say you were fighting for the Dricken or Frogzard team? No matter-- when either side hits 100% and wins, the rusty iron gates to Mystcrot Manor will creak open and Mogloween will begin! 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. Pssst... Guardians. We snuck a special Pumpkin Travel form into Mogloween release for you. We think it looks smashing.
P.P.S. The new Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian may be going up for testing on the PTR next week

notes.title: Talk Like a Pirate Day 2017
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8ad933067c0d38382a44b3948177e1a07b8a4a1a.jpg

Talk Like a Pirate Day Weekend!

Avast, ye' lilly livered land lubbers-- AdventureQuest 3D be celebrating its 1st ever Talk Like a Pirate Day. Raid a DC shop full o' booty to be walk'n the plank in style, har har.
See the full post on the official www.AQ3D.com website

What is Talk Like a Pirate Day?

Shivery me timbers! Next Tuesday, September 19th, is the official International Talk Like a Pirate Day (Or "TLAPD" if ye be one'o dem abbrever-inating scallywags). It is a one-day holiday where we... well, me matey, the name pretty much sums it up. Created by John Baur & Mark Summers, we have been celebrating it every single year in our video games. Did you know the infamous Captain Rhubarb's arrived during our 1st  Talk Like a Pirate Day in the original AdventureQuest?

http://www.aq3d.com/media/2775/tlapd-gif.gif

Captain Rhubarb's Pirate Shop

Captain Rhubarb is visiting the town of Battleon for a short time. Talk to him and check out his shop full of cosmetic DC seasonal loot.


Pirate Hook Hand - 250 DC
Eye patch - 100 DC
Pirate Hat & Eye patch - 100 DC
Pirate Anchor (Weapon) - 250 DC
Big Pirate Cutlass - 250 DC
Anchor on your Back - 500 DC
King's Cutlass - 250 DC
Pirate Shell Shoulders - 500 DC
Naval Shell Shoulders - 500 DC
Leather Pirate Coat (Armor) - 1100 DC
Leather Pirate Hat - 100 DC
Leather Pirate Gloves - 150 DC
Leather Pirate Boots - 150 DC
Leather Pirate Belt - 100 DC
Naval Commander Coat (Armor) - 1100 DC
Naval Commander Eye Patch - 100 DC
Naval Commander Hat - 100 DC
Naval Commander Gloves - 150 DC
Naval Commander Boots - 150 DC
Naval Commander Belt - 100 DC
Naval Commander Shoulders - 500 DC
Naval Commander Cutlass - 250 DC


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f9c45c4f5cfd8115f022c9d8e70002db748bf68b.jpg

GET IT ALL! Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017

Permanently unlock every item from the 2017 Talk Like a Pirate Day Shop

Want to have every item? Want to have permanent access to every item year round without using up any of that precious bank space? Buy the "Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017" for 4,900 DC. This is a special quest item-- turn it in to Captain Rhubarb, and you will permanently unlock ALL of the items from the first ever AdventureQuest 3D Talk Like a Pirate Day. It will also give you a RARE badge.

That's right! The character page badge that you get for unlocking the 2017 TLAPD collection is RARE. Each year's collection will have its own badge so this is your ONLY CHANCE to get it! 

The entire collection will be available to you through a shop which contains all the items for 0 gold (meaning you can freely get it, delete it, and get it again whenever you want.)

If ye purchase the Pirate Collector's Bounty 2017, ye can access it from Captain Rhubarb until he leaves or from Melodia in Yulgar's Inn at any time.

Kickstarter Alpha Pirate Bonus

Alpha Pirate Shell Shoulders, Gloves, and Pirate Sword Back Item!

AdventureQuest 3D keeps getting better, and in our next major release we will have the new Warrior, Rogue, Mage, and Guardian classes. Once you fall in love with those, we will rapidly be releasing Dragonslayer, Paladin, Necromancer, Ninja, and... Alpha Pirate-- which will be our first ranged Pistol class. We really wanted to surprise you by having it ready for this event, but it will be worth the wait. So, for this special event, we put bonus gifts in your Alpha Pirate shop at the Founder's sanctuary to give you more pieces to your perma-rare set-- Alpha Pirate Shell Shoulders, Gloves, and a Pirate Sword Back Item!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/3b024d8cb36d50bc346d12e47d9a13523a1f3e26.jpg

How to Talk Like a Pirate

Thee first thing ye need to know ‘bout becomin’ a pirate be crucial: ye gotta believe yer a pirate! If ye don’t truly believe ye be a Swashbuckler, then ain't nobody else gonna be fooled!

Best follow these steps below!


We pirates don’t be good at speakin’. We scowl a lot, and we like to mutter most o’ our words. Best get used to it, matey!
Ye gotta run yer words together. Ye gotta slur. Don’t use no proper sentences, neither!
If ye still have yer hands, use a motherload o’ gestures. Movin’ yer hands about when ye speak be key to a pirate’s life. It also be good fer ye circulation!
 Pirates be loud n’ lusty. Th' louder ye be, th' smart’r ye sound!
Never say “you” or “your” unless ye wishes to walk thee plank! It be “ye” an’ “yer” in th' Pirate’s life! Savvy?
Oh, and it be “me” and not no “mine”! Fer example, “that be me sword, ye no-good, two-toothed, thievin’ scallywag!”
Drop th' “g” after words endin’ in “ing”. There be no need fer that “g” after many words, like goin’, and questin’, and fishin’, and swimmin’!
Make up words if ye have to! We pirates don’t be minding a wee bit o’ hornswaggling!
Never leave port without yer good luck charm, or there be mighty dire consequences! I never leaves home without me lucky skull beret!


On behalf o’ th' Aaaaaaartix Entertainment crew, ye be ready fer Talk Like a Pirate Day! Grab ye cutlass and ye hat, and don’t be forgettin’ yer lucky charm! At any time that ye be needin’ a quick reminder, come back ‘n get a refresher! Savvy, pirate?

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team
(My Twitter & Facebook)

See more of what we are working on at www.AQ3D.com

notes.title: Greenguard Forest is LIVE!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c927ef11c703a418e8cbee133626347c085d4053.jpg

The grass really is greener on this side

"OMG! I can transform into a Bush!" - a random player who should have been talking about the world plot, cinematics, mini-bosses, surprises, secrets, challenges, puns, and ...yup, you really can find a secret that lets you transform into a bush.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/065e62a4766780ba7c9cafc29b9a3003977ef83f.jpg

The World Plot Begins

Who is this strange scythebow weilding guy? What does that gold symbol on his chest mean? Who does his hair? Wait... scythebow? How do you use a bow made out of two scythes!? 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/a8543f1a6465eb4c1f2ea99d49cd9bec9a11c978.jpg

"Feels like an Artix Entertainment game now!"

Check out the new Greenguard and you will find we not only listened to your feedback, but also poured in a little of the secret sauce. (R.I.P "The Grind") 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/99ef5a1a35ef3b57a144a2df45154f47a8743dc2.jpg

The Zard Hunter

Go into the field with the world's foremost Frogzard Expert. He knows them inside and out... literally.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/f4a0b43c384b024de6b0ed538b7e6f1a9d1a15ca.jpg

King Sneed got himself a Frogzard Mount

He also now lives atop an impressively tall Sneevil Tree fort. Perhaps you can claim that box crown for yourself?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/45556cd4dcfadced7f4a930bb7849460eeb0e4f3.jpg

Brutalcorn Lives!

50% Unicorn, 50% BRUTAL!!!!!! Do you have what it takes to challenge our dude-bro version of Monty Python's Black Knight?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/16916e0d48285fc6d6ac39f59196cad395e6e8b0.jpg

Better Crafting!

As you progress through the story you will unlock different things to craft-- starting with the Zardscale armor set. You will find it is much faster and more fun to make items now. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/8867c6fba3b05dde85d9ce7956abe90a234cb7db.jpg

Challenge Fights & Secrets!

We hid things around Greenguard forest for you... most you can handle yourself with the right gear. But to battle the Clawg, you will need to bring a few tough friends. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/b6b3a8f13083ced44156a1d22b0256768eb22cb1.jpg

Beating around the... BUSH!

There is a secret hidden in the forest which... if found, will allow any hero to transform themselves into a bush at will. Excels at hiding, sneaking, espionage, and x-treme bush racing. Moves at 0% travel speed.

notes.title: The Bank is now open!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/6feb9342b6b5b4a30638db0e72072a0e508c32b9.jpg

Welcome to the Bank of Battleon

Within the Bank of Battleon you will find The Master Vault, Security Runs, Ornithons (first look at the bird-like race), Keyblades, Keystaffs, Monicles, Nightlocke upgrades, and more. The bank is a level 6 area, with scaling adventures and rewards for heroes of all levels. 

Read the full post at http://www.aq3d.com/news/bank/

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/ed0a61e3009d6673554ed1225ad557c2782a2291.gif

New Items in the Bank


Monicle (Security Rank 5)
Top Hat (Security Rank 5)
Top Hat & Monicle (Why not both?, Security Rank 5)
Plutocrat Long Coat (Security Rank 3, Crafting)
Plutocrat Gloves (Security Rank 2, Crafting)
Plutocrat Boots (Security Rank 1, Crafting)
Plutocrat Belt (Security Rank 4, Crafting)
Black Raven Wings (DCs)
Black Raven Head Morph (DCs)
Vault Keeper Robes (Gold... and it's GREEEEEN!)
The Letter Opener (Gold)
Plague Doctor's Master (Craftable, Security Rank 10)
Ornate Nightlocke Weapon Upgrades (Craftable, Security Rank 10)
Master Vault Keyblade (Reward for completing Master Vault)
Master Vault Keystaff (Craftable after completing Master Vault)
Legion Chrono-Keystaff (DC / Unlocks after Master Vault)
...there are other items in there too.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/1a20ba9f25265f14c4be209512c79c928fa9a9a0.jpg

The Master Vault
Want to see the physical location where every hero's bank vault is located... including yours? Enter the Master Vault... if you can. It is and most important of the Bank's three vaults. Just be careful in there, I hear the gold portal is prone to breaking.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/e37899d58b8626b4117362fba690d67239ae39c5.jpg

Security Vault Runs - Solo, 2, and 5 Player
We listened to your feedback about Random Adventures and are trying something out in the bank release. You can now choose to run the bank's random adventures solo, 2-player, or 5-player. We balanced it so it was winnable if you played alone, a little faster with a friend, and the 5-player version is a challenge, but an extremely rewarding one. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/526b8c752f56fa588546fd3c16f2640b1daa8e7f.jpg

Posting this on steam only... we added an important new character to this release who is likely to be reoccurring.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/c0e6eceaceacbc703276be486458b626d26c8719.jpg

This release feels "alive"

We really hope you enjoy the bank. It still feels like we are getting better with each new release. The first time I walked in the bank and saw the Ornithons, I had that feeling of wonder-- you know the kind that Harry Potter movies gave me. I was surprised when I saw another player tweet the same thing. While this release started small, it ended up MUCH LARGER than expected. This release has me really excited for what is next... starting with Greenguard and Ashfall's Part 3. We will be assembling them while the coders get a major game version update ready. Until then, have fun and... oh! I have a post on classes coming up for you next.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/08a333809f6ea5e8787c8d1978674a46d9f8159c.jpg

Battle on!

notes.title: Frost Castle - New Random Adventure!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/222a0cf2a6e397a64331bfaf27cbcab8541319d1.jpg

Join us in AdventureQuest 3D and go on random adventures to encounter… the Frost Castle! It is hands down our best looking random adventure are yet. New items are now available to craft at Cysero’s forge including our first ever wands. You will also notice that monsters… make noise now. Read on for details-- and see you in game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/abaab15af4c29298ac71b8ed31a577e75676a5ae.jpg

New Items to Craft at Cysero’s Forge
Are you the type of mage, wizard, warlock, erm... magic user who prefers casting spells with wands? Then you are in luck! There are two wands among the new craftable items at the forge in town:


 Blue Glass Wand (Elegant and powerful)
 Bone Wand (for magic users who prefer… the darkness)
 Abyss Blade (One of Dage’s finest)
 Elegant Abyss Blade (Stylish?)


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/bbe97890bc58965ecd1d2e6393494a1c46f200a8.jpg

The Frost Castle 
Now when you go on a random adventure, there is a chance you will end up in the Frost Castle. It is unquestionably the best looking random adventure/dungeon yet... and I particularly like how the bridge takes you outside, giving a glimpse of the bigger world you are adventuring in.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/fd6e2a16e82a02d672ea1c2426ac07dd93555d33.jpg

The bank is run by Ornithons? 
The Ornithon race is best known for their sharp beaks, deadly talons, and accounting skills. You will be meeting them soon when the bank in town opens up (like, next).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/70224c5496e3ae3117c1314c94747c9ca1de9c4e.jpg

Greenguard Forest Update coming!
As you may already know, we are updating every area from Greenguard to Doomwood with all of our new features to bring them up to the quality & fun of our newer “Dragons of Ashfall” areas. Check our official site and read my regular design notes posts for sneaky peeks, and clues to some of the interesting things being added… including, the game’s main storyline plot >_>. (Wait.. the game has a story plot!)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2f6e6b557097a29f9e44f3b5c76c4dd69042583c.jpg

Bots/Cheats/Hacks get the Ban Hammer
We know you would never do it, but just getting the word out there that we have taken a strict no-bots policy. Protect your account (and warn others to protect their accounts too.) 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4183ffecded410a3497829a55ef0d05228c0df83.jpg

New Sound Manager - LIVE!
Warlic did an overhaul of AdventureQuest 3D's sound engine. We now have monster soundFX, ambient tracks, and music tracks. Best of all, any object in the game can now have 3D positional sound placed on it. We added some sounds on monsters... run around and battle stuff to see what they sound like. Give us feedback, because now that we have the new Sound Manager, we are going to do a HUGE pass to improve all of the game's sounds.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d2fcacb274fe13db4d51c77a8f22fdd3393a6d50.jpg

(New players were in for an unexpected surprise)

Thank you & coming next!
Thank you for being a part of this growing world. Greenguard Forest, Ashfall Part III, and the Bank (Including the new creature race and bank vault run) are in development now. This week I approved the new female faces, and Oishii is working on expressions while Xero implements beards & braids. We plan to release new hairstyles, new face customization options (eye color, etc), and beards and braids along with the Barbershop. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. We are also releasing a "Hot Fix" patch this week (depending on submission time) which will solve the TOP 5 Bugs of AdventureQuest 3D!

The Ornithon race is best known for their sharp beaks, deadly talons, and accounting skills. You will be meeting them soon when the bank in town opens up (like, next).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/70224c5496e3ae3117c1314c94747c9ca1de9c4e.jpg

Greenguard Forest Update coming!
As you may already know, we are updating every area from Greenguard to Doomwood with all of our new features to bring them up to the quality & fun of our newer “Dragons of Ashfall” areas. http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/2f6e6b557097a29f9e44f3b5c76c4dd69042583c.jpg

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/4183ffecded410a3497829a55ef0d05228c0df83.jpg

Warlic did an overhaul of AdventureQuest 3D's sound engine. We now have monster soundFX, ambient tracks, and music tracks. Best of all, any object in the game can now have 3D positional sound placed on it. We added some sounds on monsters... run around and battle stuff to see what they sound like. Give us feedback, because now that we have the new Sound Manager, we are going to do a HUGE pass to improve all of the game's sounds.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26011876/d2fcacb274fe13db4d51c77a8f22fdd3393a6d50.jpg

(New players were in for an unexpected surprise)

Thank you & coming next!
Thank you for being a part of this growing world. Greenguard Forest, Ashfall Part III, and the Bank (Including the new creature race and bank vault run) are in development now. This week I approved the new female faces, and Oishii is working on expressions while Xero implements beards & braids. We plan to release new hairstyles, new face customization options (eye color, etc), and beards and braids along with the Barbershop. 

Battle on!
Artix & the AdventureQuest 3D Team

P.S. We are also releasing a "Hot Fix" patch this week (depending on submission time) which will solve the TOP 5 Bugs of AdventureQuest 3D!
